series.description: An anthology series hosted by Betty Furness in the first season, Desi Arnaz in the second. Stories came from several genres, often based on fact. A two part episode was spun off as the popular show The Untouchables.

series.title: Sunday Brunch
series.description: Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer host  Sunday Brunch , packed with celebrity guests, tasty cookery and chat.

series.title: The Institute
series.description: When 12-year-old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped, he awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and who are all possessed of unusual abilities. In a nearby town, haunted former police officer Tim Jamieson has come looking to start a new life, but the peace and quiet won't last, as his story and Luke's are destined to collide.

series.title: Complicit
series.description: Following an unexpected death, Jen Molloy finds herself trapped by a lie that threatens to unravel her life, forcing her to make impossible choices to protect the people she loves.

series.title: Nightswimming
series.description: The series creates a multi layered narrative, twisting and turning with every revelation as Matthew returns to his home in Portugal where he was convicted of the brutal murder of his family years earlier.  Weaving between past and present,  Nightswimming  picks apart the events that led up to the devastating night when Matthew's wife, Beth, and two teenage sons, Alex and Simon, were brutally attacked in their beachfront home, while Matthew was performing his nightly ritual, swimming in the ocean.  In the present, Matthew mounts his own investigation into the crime that tore his life apart, confronting old friends, revisiting broken relationships and interrogating the people who built the case against him. But as he slowly unravels what happened a decade before, he struggles to plead his own innocence, when he discovers it was someone much closer to home that helped to put him away.

series.title: Blue Lights
series.description: For three police recruits in Belfast, the pressure is immense. Facing criminal gangs and divided communities, they don't know who to trust. The odds are they won't all make it.

series.title: Stacey Dooley's Australia: Off the Beaten Track
series.description: Stacey Dooley, heads into the wilderness to explore Australia's most remote communities: from an isolated cattle station, to deep within the rainforest, to a very special island.

series.title: I Was Actually There
series.description: What if our history was told by the people who were actually there? What if this retelling came with all its unvarnished, irreverent and occasionally contradictory humanity still intact?   I Was Actually There  will interview Australians who were there when our most defining and memorable events happened. What was it like to witness the miraculous rescue at the Beaconsfield Mine? Or flee the raging waters of the Boxing Day tsunami? Or wag school to meet the Beatles in their prime?  Through powerful contemporary interviews with diverse and colourful characters, the show will ask these Australians what they saw, how they reacted and how it changed them. While looking to the past, the series will reflect who we are now and examine why these moments still resonate.

series.title: The Galway Bay Murders
series.description: The series is set in the west coast of Ireland and sees seasoned NYPD detective Nora Savage take a career break from the NYPD following a traumatic event and moving to her family home. Expecting a change of pace, Nora is unexpectedly pulled into a murder investigation involving a female climate activist. As the investigation builds to a tense and savage climax, it pushes Nora and the squad into a thrilling hunt for the killer.

series.title: Warriors
series.description: What does it take to be a warrior? Travel the globe alongside Green Beret Terry Schappert, in an action-packed journey as he experiences the training, rituals and weapons of history's most iconic warrior cultures. Terry probes deeply into the spirit of an ancient warrior - from Vikings, Samurai, Barbarians and Knights - revealing a side of these fighters that is seldom seen and rarely understood. Because Terry is a Special Forces soldier, he genuinely relates to warriors of the past, helping viewers understand what made them fight and die for causes greater than themselves. Throwing the battle ax of a Viking, firing the ballista of a Roman legion, experiencing the time honored rites of the Samurai and the chivalric traditions of the English Knight - Terry fully immerses himself into each warrior culture. Learning first hand the ingenious technology of their ancient weapons and bringing dramatic history to life.  Warriors  takes viewers to the very lands on which these ancient forces fought - from the jungles of Central America to the savannahs of South Africa.

series.title: American Pickers: Best Of
series.description: In small towns, and along America's back roads, treasures are waiting to be uncovered–valuable relics from history that are hidden in junk piles, buried in barns and stacked in garages. It takes special experts to find these lost artifacts and hopefully turn rust to riches. Mike and Frank look back at their best picks.

series.title: Treasure Island
series.description: Treasure Island  charts the transformation of teenager Jim Hawkins from sheltered boy to emboldened young pirate. When Jim gets his hands on a legendary treasure map, his mother Bess' clever and decisive actions leave him holding valuable knowledge that puts both of their lives in danger.

series.title: Bump Up Business
series.description: Bump Up Business is about a Kpop idol named Eden who's about to debut, he encounters an idol under the same agency as him named Ji Hoon. Not long after seeing Ji Hoon, Eden is told that he can only make his debut by doing a Business Gay Performance with Ji Hoon. Eden wants to reject such a reality but he follows what his agency wants him to do. Eden and Ji Hoon still squabble but over time they start to get closer. Misunderstandings between Ji Hoon and Eden begin to build up, will they be able to clear up the misunderstandings and find their true feelings for each other?

series.title: Tell Me That You Love Me
series.description: A healing melodrama about the fate of Cha Jin Woo, a deaf person who is used to express emotions through pictures instead of words, and Jung Moo Eun, who expresses her heart with her voice.

series.title: Love Song for Illusion
series.description: Love Song for Illusion  is about a King who has two opposite personalities and an assassin who approaches him to avenge the death of her family but ends up falling in love with him after she is taken in as the King's concubine.

series.title: Maestra: Strings of Truth
series.description: Cha Se Eum used to be a violinist, but she is now a conductor of an orchestra. She has pursued her career boldly and with passion. She is now in a position where others are envious. What others don't know is that Cha Se Eum carries a secret. That secret will shake her life. Meanwhile, mysterious cases take place within her orchestra. Cha Se Eum looks into the cases and approaches the truth surrounding her.

series.title: Welcome to Samdal-ri
series.description: After losing his mother—who worked as a haenyeo —at a young age due to a mistaken weather report, Jo Yong Pil makes up his mind to become a weather forecaster and protect the elders of his hometown. However, his passion and refusal to let misinformation slide earns him a reputation at work as a stubborn troublemaker who isn't afraid to argue with his boss.

series.title: Night Has Come
series.description: A mystery teen drama that takes place when a class of second-year high school students is suddenly forced to play mafia games in real life during their retreat.

series.title: Secret Playlist
series.description: Han Joo is your ordinary university student… except for the fact that she's also the up-and-coming Metube cover artist, PLII. When popular boy group member Levi takes notice of PLII and requests to collaborate, Han Joo will do anything to hide her secret identity. But as the two grow closer working on a class project, Han Joo's cover begins to unravel. Will Levi discover her secret?

series.title: Karma
series.description: A fateful accident intertwines six lives in a thrilling tale of karma and crime, where each must face their own dark truths and connections. A hit-and-run. A cover-up. A debt-fueled murder plot.  Karma  weaves together the fates of six characters, each bound by a single, irreversible moment. The Witness observed a mysterious accident in the dead of night, setting the Unspoken Fate in motion. The Surgeon, haunted by a lifelong trauma, and confronted by the painful past she vowed never to face again. The Debtor & the Outsider, jobless and trapped, plunge headlong into the fate of dark deals. The Doctor & the Alluring Girlfriend, as one fateful mistake on a dark night spirals uncontrollably into a catastrophic accident. Six lives, one inescapable fate.

series.title: My Happy Ending
series.description: Seo Jae Won, a woman who is obsessed with and chases after success as she had an unfortunate childhood, trying to escape from her unhealthy desires and obsessions.

series.title: Chart Running Scholar
series.description: 'Scholar Running the Chart' is a time stock romance about a Joseon scholar Yuanta who travels to the modern era and meets Geum Min-ji, a clerk from the MZ generation. , and discovers a talent for investing in stocks that he did not know.

series.title: Look at My Shoulder, It's Dislocated
series.description: Eun Ji-won, Kyuhyun, and MINO enjoy drinks, snacks, chats, and friendly banter with a variety of guests.

series.title: Marry My Husband
series.description: Kang Ji-won, a terminally ill cancer patient, is killed by her husband and best friend after she witnesses them having an affair. She wakes up 10 years before the incident and decides to seek revenge with the help of Yu Ji-hyuk, a director at the company where she works. Now, she must reclaim her fate and eliminate the trash from her life.

series.title: Like Flowers in Sand
series.description: Kim Bae Doo is the youngest born of a prestigious ssireum family and competes on the ssireum team for the Geosan County Office. Despite his extraordinary talent, Baek Doo is thinking of retiring from the sport altogether. However, when childhood friend Oh Yoo Kyung walks back into his life and becomes the leader of the ssireum team, he u-turns on his plans to retire.

series.title: Between Him and Her
series.description: It is the story of a long-time couple whose relationship has cooled down and is threatened due to the seven-year itch. Han Sung Ok is a jewelry worker in the business run by her and her boyfriend, Jung Hyun Sung, who works as a fashion designer. One night, Han Sung Ok and Jung Hyun Sung come face to face with each other in front of a motel elevator. They are each accompanied by another person.

series.title: Flex x Cop
series.description: A fun-loving rich boy gets entangled in an incident and joins a violent crime investigation team. By mobilizing his enormous wealth and personal connections, the third-generation chaebol detective catches criminals who are beyond the reach of the police.

series.title: Captivating the King
series.description: A cruel love story between King Lee In, who is in danger of both royal and political power struggles, and Kang Hee Soo, who tries to seduce the King and get revenge, but gets seduced instead

series.title: Knight Flower
series.description: Set in the Joseon era,  Knight Flower  is an action-comedy drama starring Lee Ha Nee as Jo Yeo Hwa, a woman who has lived a quiet and modest life as a virtuous widow by day for 15 years. However, she is secretly leading a double life: at night, she valiantly sneaks out to help and take care of those in need.

series.title: In Your Radiant Season
series.description: Chan lives every day like it is summer vacation. Haran is trapped in a lonely winter. When their forgotten past reunites them, Chan is determined to gift her another spring. Through laughter and tears, they face winter together and reach their spring in this heartwarming romance.

series.title: NCT Universe: LASTART
series.description: Finally, to find the last fixed members of NCT, the journey of "NCT Universe : LASTART" has set sail. Through fierce training, 10 trainees have climbed up the steps to become candidates. "NCT Universe : LASTART" selects the last NCT debut members. Only 4 can become the final member and make it as NCT with SMROOKIES.

series.title: A Shop for Killers
series.description: Set in modern-day Korea,  A Shop For Killers  sees college student Jung Ji Ahn diving for cover in her childhood home after a series of highly skilled assassins get her in their sights. Desperately fighting to survive, Ji Ahn will begin to remember invaluable lessons her uncle taught her before his apparent suicide, drawing on them to help her stay alive. Confused and cornered, Ji Ahn will have to work fast to uncover her uncle's hidden past and figure out why so many people are desperate to gain access to the house and the extensive arsenal hidden inside.

series.title: Doctor Slump
series.description: A rom-com about doctors who are in a slump as they try to resuscitate their lives. Their story captures the love and growth of two characters who live in a rooftop house after quitting their jobs as doctors.

series.title: Mercy for None
series.description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death -- embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

series.title: Branding in Seongsu
series.description: A relentless marketing executive and a warm-hearted intern are always at odds with each other but everything takes a wild turn when their souls switch after an unexpected kiss.

series.title: Wedding Impossible
series.description: As a struggling actress, Na Ah Jung is the first to admit that her career isn't exactly soaring. Able to land various jobs as an extra, Ah Jung struggles to get the attention and traction she needs to bring her talent into the spotlight. However, her various roles portraying a married woman come in handy when her lifelong friend, Lee Do Han approaches her with an unexpected request.

series.title: The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call
series.description: To create a top-tier trauma center, a war-seasoned doctor arrives bringing his blunt but skilled ways to transform his team into life-saving mavericks.

series.title: Without Blood or Tears
series.description: A tragic story of sisters Lee Hye Won and Bae Do Eun who were separated at a young age due to their parents' divorce. When they reunite 20 years later after living very different lives, Bae Do Eun begins to burn with ambition.

series.title: A Killer Paradox
series.description: When one accidental killing leads to another, an average college student finds himself stuck in an endless cat-and-mouse chase with a shrewd detective.

series.title: Love Next Door
series.description: A romantic comedy that tells the story of a woman trying to reboot her life after making mistakes, and her mother's friend's son, who is her living dark side.

series.title: Tish Tash
series.description: An exciting adventure with Tish and her imaginary friend Tash!

series.title: Super Rich in Korea
series.description: Super Rich in Korea  unveils a realm where luxury cars and haute couture are everyday sights, and exclusive parties are the norm. It's a deep dive into a lifestyle where wealth meets Korean cultural flair.

series.title: Wonderful World
series.description: Eun Soo Hyun is a psychology professor and a famous writer, but her life has completely changed. Her young son dies unjustly. Making things worse, the person responsible for her son's death isn't punished by the law. Eun Soo Hyun loses hope in this world. She decides to punish the person responsible for her son's death by herself. Her life is still in pain and despair. Somehow, Eun Soo Hyun gets involved with other people who suffer from pain similar to hers and solves their mysterious cases. They slowly get healed in the process.

series.title: The Time Hotel
series.description: The Time Hotel  is a hotel survival survival where 10 guests try to survive as the last one in the 'Time Hotel', where you can buy everything with time instead of money, and check out as soon as you run out of time. In 'Time Hotel', you can use everything from restaurants to cafes and room service by paying for time instead of money. Prize money up to 300 million won will be given to the final winner, who succeeds in managing time until the end by using the prize money earned through the game. From alliances to lies, betrayals, and conspiracies, it seems that we can get a glimpse of the colorful human group through the appearances of those who carry out their own survival strategies.

series.title: The Impossible Heir
series.description: When the illegitimate son of a conglomerate owner partners with his ambitious childhood friend, the duo will stop at nothing to seize their place at the top of the societal food chain.

series.title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
series.description: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs --- proving love endures across time.

series.title: Pyramid Game
series.description: Every Thursday afternoon, once a month, students at Sarang High School cast their votes in a popularity poll. The result? A brutal ranking system that determines the entire social hierarchy of the school. After starting at the bottom, can new transfer student Su Ji make her way to the top of the pyramid? Or will she topple the game altogether?

series.title: Midnight Photo Studio
series.description: Seo Ki Joo is a photographer and runs a small photo studio. He is the 7th owner of the photo studio and the shop is only for ghosts. Ki Joo takes portraits of the ghosts that come into the store. Han Bom is a lawyer who is passionate about her work and does not tolerate injustice. Somehow, she ends up in a partnership with Ki Joo's photo studio. The studio also has two employees: Assistant Manager Go and Baek Nam Gu. Assistant Manager Go is in charge of bringing in ghosts as customers, and Nam Gu is in charge of taking care of small chores around the store.

series.title: Nothing Uncovered
series.description: Seo Jung Won is an investigative reporter and the host of the current affairs television program "Grabbed by the Collar." Thanks to her unique and straightforward way of exposing all kinds of torts committed by culprits—all whilst making sarcastic remarks—she gains great popularity and attracts the general public's attention. When Jung Won is accused of murder, she joins with detective Kim Tae Hyun, and sets out to find the truth. Also helping her are her husband Seol Woo Jae and Woo Jae, respectively.

series.title: Missing Crown Prince
series.description: Set in the Joseon era about a crown prince who is kidnapped by the woman who is set to become his wife. While on the run for their lives, romance winds up blossoming between them.

series.title: Love Mafia
series.description: Young single men and women come to Love School in search of true love. However, two real-life couples are hiding among them. If single people become a couple, they receive 10,000 dollars as a gesture of the show supporting them. However, the real couples, also called the mafia couples, try to thwart the single people's effort to find love. If a single person and another person of the mafia couples get matched up, the person from the mafia gets the prize money of 10,000 dollars. Sung Si Kyung, known as a master of love and for his diverse careers and sharp wit, Shindong, Soyou, and Lee Hye Sung will host the show, making witty talks and exciting guesses. A real variety show about love, which is entirely different from everything you've seen so far, will give the audience the thrill and fun of a drama unfolded by real-life couples mixed with singles. Look forward to seeing which couple will get the prize money and fruit of love!

series.title: Hide
series.description: Hide  follows the story of a woman, Na Moon Young, whose husband, Cha Sung Jae vanishes into thin air. As she traces the truth behind her husband's disappearance, she stumbles upon unbearable secrets.

series.title: Chief Detective 1958
series.description: Park Young Han is a young detective from Hwangcheon. He becomes furious at the reality of human dignity being violated and he struggles to deal with it. He teams up with his colleague detectives at the Jongnam Police Station in Seoul.

series.title: HOPE ON THE STREET
series.description: j-hope is a member of the 21st century pop icon group BTS.  HOPE ON THE STREET  is a 6-episode docuseries that highlights j-hope's story and love for dancing as he begins a new journey in his 12th year since debut, returning to his dancer roots. Accompanied by his former instructor, the popping champion Boogaloo Kin, j-hope explores the streets of Osaka, Seoul, Paris, New York, and Gwangju, meeting inspiring street dancers along the way. Follow j-hope as he pursues a dream connecting his past, present, and future.

series.title: Hierarchy
series.description: The top 0.01% of students control law and order at Jooshin High School, but a secretive transfer student chips a crack in their indomitable world.

series.title: Blood Free
series.description: A drama that depicts a new era of artificially cultured meat, at a time when bleeding meat disappears from the human table, and begins with people questioning BF's behavior inside and outside, while BF, a biotechnology company that ends millions of years of 'domination' and 'subject peoples' relationships, dominates the cultured meat market.

series.title: Unmasked
series.description: A comedy drama that tells the story of an investigative reporting crew, centered on the team leader Trigger, who is full of a sense of justice, and the PD, a fierce individualist, who uncover the truth behind mysterious events and save a program that is on the verge of being abolished.  In modern-day Seoul, a crack team of investigative journalists fight for their careers after broadcasting a controversial story. With time running out, the team are given an impossible task if they want to save their jobs – solve a twenty-year-old cold case involving a famous actor who disappeared without a trace.

series.title: Light Shop
series.description: The living and the dead intersecting as this world and the afterlife are connected through a store selling lighting.  A series about six lost strangers who find themselves drawn to a mysterious shop that inexplicably holds the key to their past, present and future. With the help of their loved ones, will the strangers be able to escape the world between life and death, and return to their normal lives?

series.title: Uncle Samsik
series.description: Set in 1960s South Korea, the series follows two men through their bromance and the obstacles they face during a turbulent time in the country's history.

series.title: Risqué Business: The Netherlands and Germany
series.description: Shin Dong-youp and Sung Si-kyung boldly explore the sex cultures of the Netherlands and Germany, mixing hands-on experiences with revealing interviews.

series.title: Beauty and Mr. Romantic
series.description: A love story about an actress who falls to the bottom overnight and a producer's effort to try and get her back on her feet because he loves her. A cheerful family drama that reveals the truth of the case and restores love and justice through revenge and a family's desire to go through confusion due to family conflicts.

series.title: Lovely Runner
series.description: Im Sol is devastated by the sudden and tragic death of her idol Ryu Sun-Jae, a former swimmer turned K-pop star. But in the midst of her grief, she magically travels back to 2008 - when Sun-Jae was only 19 years old! Sol is delighted that she can help him escape his sad future fate, and makes it her mission to change the future ... and maybe even find true love in the process. Will her attempts to change the course of the past succeed - or could they have unexpected consequences?

series.title: Brave Yong Soo Jung
series.description: A romantic revenge drama with Yong Soo Jung, an outspoken winner who dreams of Im Sang Ok, the modern version of Colossus, and Yeo Eui Joo, a frugaller who entrusts her with his fate.

series.title: Suji & Uri
series.description: A heart-warming and healing romance story about Jin Soo Ji, a former celebrity doctor and Chae Woo Ri, a reckless rookie doctor.

series.title: The Midnight Romance in Hagwon
series.description: A secret and sweet real-life romance between veteran academy instructor Seo Hye Jin and her flirty student Lee Joon Ho, who returns after 10 years and stirs her heart.

series.title: Frankly Speaking
series.description: A childish and rude life-changing comic melodrama in which announcer Song Ki-baek meets passionate entertainment writer On Woo-joo.

series.title: Boys Be Brave
series.description: JinWoo, is a young man who finds himself living with his crush, KiSub, who entered his home uninvited and crashed on his couch for a little too long. The narrative also explores the relationship between Sunny and InHo, who hold onto a secret from their high school days.

series.title: Connection
series.description: The crumbling friendship of friends is revealed as they uncover the death of a high school friend who left behind a five billion won insurance money.

series.title: The Atypical Family
series.description: A story about Bok Gwi Joo who has extraordinary abilities saving Da Hae, his fated destiny.

series.title: The 8 Show
series.description: Eight strangers with unique stories join a show taking place in an eight-story building where they must entertain an invisible crowd to win prize money.

series.title: I Am Solo: Love Forever
series.description: Who found a happily ever after and who's still happily searching? Cast members from "I'm SOLO" reveal what happened in their lives after the show aired.

series.title: Love Naggers
series.description: A panel of love experts weigh in on romantic relationships from the quirky to the scandalous, combing over text messages and delighting in re-enactments.

series.title: Dare to Love Me
series.description: A full-fledged defense romantic comedy about Shin Yoon Bok, a pupil from Seongsan village with Confucianism in his bones, and Kim Hong Do, an aggressive modern woman who only knows how to go straight.

series.title: Bitter Sweet Hell
series.description: Bitter Sweet Hell  tells the story of Korea's best psychological counselor Young Won and her mother-in-law Sa Gang facing each other's secrets and truths due to their husband and son.

series.title: DNA Lover
series.description: So Jin, a genetic researcher who loves DNA, decides to end her relationship with a playboy boyfriend and sets out to find a genetically compatible partner for a happy relationship. Whom among the two men that So Jin meets, obstetrician-gynecologist Yeon Woo and firefighter Kang Hoon, will be the perfect match for her? A captivating story intertwined with genetics! This story portrays the struggles, love, and everyday lives of young friends.

series.title: Dreaming of a Freaking Fairytale
series.description: In this 21st century hybrid fairy tale, a woman is determined to become a Cinderella, so she gets a job at an exclusive club and sets her sights on her future Prince Charming. He might be handsome and wealthy, but he's also an arrogant jerk with trust issues, and no interest in wom

series.title: Cityboy_Log
series.description: Four handsome men aspiring to be models, actors, and idols start a vlog for their work trip to Japan, capturing the rising tensions and blossoming friendships between them, and how they've grown as individuals, when they return to Seoul.

series.title: My Sweet Mobster
series.description: A romance filled with excitement between Ji Hwan, the eldest brother who clears his dark past, and Eun Ha, the mini-unnie who plays with the children.

series.title: Gangnam B-Side
series.description: A pariah detective is pulled back into the game after his daughter's friend goes missing. The latest in a long line of women to go missing in the Gangnam area of Seoul, the detective delves back into a world of vice, drugs and corruption to uncover something that threatens to topple some of the city's wealthiest elite.

series.title: Miss Night and Day
series.description: A woman who magically switches between her 20s and 50s lands an internship at the Prosecution Service, caught between two generations and a tough boss.

series.title: When the Phone Rings
series.description: Korea's youngest presidential spokesperson finds his cold, calculated three-year marriage thrown into questions when his wife, a sign language interpreter, is mysteriously abducted.

series.title: Agents of Mystery
series.description: Six Korean celebs become field agents for a secret organization. Will they be able to team up to complete their paranormal mission within six hours?

series.title: No Way Out: The Roulette
series.description: A battle between 'the one who wants to live' and 'the one who wants to kill' amid an 'open murder appeal' with a reward of 20 billion won when the felon of the century is released from prison.

series.title: Undercover High School
series.description: A comic drama about the activities of an NIS agent who hid his identity and infiltrated as a high school student to track down the whereabouts of the missing gold bullion of Emperor Gojong

series.title: heart.zip
series.description: The mini-series is a zip file in which each episode is a special folder. The collections are "Unexpected Kisses", "Good Word Fights", "Exciting Moments", "What Happened While Recording TikTok", "Borrowed a Hidden Camera to Confess". The unusual format conveys some impressions and moments from the lives of ordinary people, helping to find reflections of themselves in the stories of the characters.

series.title: Secret Ingredient
series.description: A Korean man who gives up his entire luxurious life in Seoul in search of his childhood girlfriend, someone he's never forgotten all these years, in the hopes that she would fall in love with him, not for who they were back then or who they are now, but for what they can aspire to be: happy, fulfilled and blissfully in love with one another.

series.title: The Whirlwind
series.description: A whirlwind clash ensues when a deputy prime minister of economy stands against the prime minister who aims to uproot the corrupt powers that be.

series.title: Tarot
series.description: A brutal fate mystery series that tells the story of being trapped in the curse of tarot cards twisted by a moment's choice.

series.title: Scandal
series.description: A fierce, passionate battle begins between a woman who wants it all and a woman who risks it all for revenge.

series.title: My Name is Gabriel
series.description: A program where you live 'the real life of that person' for 72 hours under the name of one of the world's 8 billion people in a place where no one knows you.

series.title: Make Mate 1
series.description: Make Mate 1  is a program that contains the meaning of "Time to become one with MAKE friends (MATE) to create the stage you dreamed of," and it is a program that depicts the process of 36 multinational participants running toward their dream of becoming an idol. It is not a survival program involving trainees belonging to an entertainment agency but a survival program performed by ordinary boys who do not have an agency. The final debut group will debut as Makestar's new boy group.

series.title: Perfect Family
series.description: A story of the family of Choi Sun Hee, who seems to be happy and perfect to anyone, going through the death of her friend Gyeong Ho one day.

series.title: Red Swan
series.description: Oh Wan Soo, a former world-class golfer married into the powerful Hwain Group, finds herself targeted by death threats. She crosses paths with Seo Do Yoon, a bodyguard investigation a friend's death that is tied to the Hwain Group. Together, they unravel Hwain Group's secrets tainted with desire.

series.title: The Tyrant
series.description: A secret project in Korea is exposed to the U.S. The U.S. demands the termination of the project, but a delivery accident occurs during the NIS's attempt to hand over the sample. Paul, a U.S. Agent, harshly pressures the NIS after the incident and confronts the leader of the project, Director Choe. Meanwhile, Jagyeong, a key character in this case, and Lim Sang, a retired veteran, begin chasing Director Choe's subordinate, Moyong, for different reasons. Everyone gathers in the end, and an unexpected turn of events takes place as ownership of the last sample is at stake.

series.title: Unacceptable
series.description: Unacceptable  features Ed Gamble as host with two teams of comics battling to convince a studio audience of their most daft, niche, unwise or unacceptable views that they and their teammates must then defend.  Joined by some of the biggest names in comedy each week,  Unacceptable  will see a live "swingometer" track how many audience members the teams win over with their wit and punchlines as they aim to convince the crowd, with Gamble introducing a series of challenges to force them to practice what they preach.

series.title: Moomin
series.description: Moomin  is a Japanese European TV show about the inhabitants of a fictional place known as Moominvalley. The show follows Moomin and his parents Moominmamma and Momminpappa and their friends Sniff, Snufkin, Little My, Mr. Hemulen, Snorkmaiden and her inventor brother Snork.

series.title: Get Jiro
series.description: In a future Los Angeles controlled by elite chefs, a sushi master named Jiro gets embroiled in a culinary conflict, seeking vengeance through his cooking skills amidst the cutthroat restaurant scene.

series.title: Jet Lag: The Game
series.description: We play games where the world is our board.  Jet Lag: The Game  is an online reality competition centered around travel. In it, players travel to various locations to complete challenges, helping them towards a larger goal - either by claiming territory or replenishing their travel budget. With the world as the "board," each season is a unique game.

series.title: It Gets Worse
series.description: It Gets Worse  follows Ethan, Abi, and Sam - best friends from uni, soulmates for life, and dysfunctional roommates. It's been a year since they finally managed to move to London, they have collectively accomplished nothing, and now their landlord is selling up. They're getting kicked out. What now? Can they keep their friendships alive when they are dispersed across a city that seems to want them dead? Can they find a six out of ten or higher to have bad sex with? Can they get their shit together when the world is so obviously falling apart? Probably not. But they're going to have fun trying.   It Gets Worse  is a show about three young people who are starting to look around themselves - at their humiliating jobs, their non-existent love lives and their rapidly dwindling will to live - and think: wait. Wait wait WAIT. Surely it gets better than this? It has to get better than this. Right? Spoiler alert! It doesn't.

series.title: Akka
series.description: Power, revenge and legacy collide when rebel Rudra targets Bhavani's matriarchal rule over Pernuru in this gripping drama from YRF.

series.title: Little Giants
series.description: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators--lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author and expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.

series.title: RBT
series.description: Follow the police units for a unique behind-the-scenes look at RBT patrols testing for alcohol and drug affected drivers.

series.title: Sunday NFL Countdown
series.description: Sunday NFL Countdown  is a sports talk show that airs Sunday mornings during Football season where a panel of NFL experts discuss and breakdown the upcoming weekend games. This show's former names include  NFL GameDay  from 1985 to 1995,  NFL Countdown  from 1996 to 1997, and since 1998,  Sunday NFL Countdown.  This Sunday pregame talk show debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series behind host Chris Berman, who was at the helm for three decades. Taking over that role is Samantha Ponder, a one-time college football reporter and contributor. She introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players. Chris Mortensen and Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes.

series.title: The Auditors
series.description: At JU Construction Company, notorious for countless corruption cases, the audit team is busy at work. The team comprises a polar opposite duo: a cold team leader and a generous Gen Z employee. Together, they navigate through turbulent teamwork at first. Yet, as they collectively tackle diverse cases, they harmonize into an unstoppable investigative pair.

series.title: Good Partner
series.description: Facing her own divorce, seasoned divorce lawyer Cha Eun Kyung has grown jaded with the concept of Justice, instead opting for the path with the most monetary gain. This changes after she begins working with passionate rookie lawyer Han Yoo Ri, who believes in helping people regardless of the money.

series.title: The Chairman of Class 9
series.description: A delinquent 2nd-year student becomes the chairman of the board of a prestigious high school left behind by his father. Na Yi Soo may have grown up in an environment that others would envy, but he harbors hatred for his father and heads to Balhae High School, which his father cherished, in order to seek revenge. The process of change between Yi Soo, who has lived a rougher life than anyone else, and the nation's most elite students who have lived upright lives, as they get to know each other, and the love that blooms in the process, will be dynamically unfolded.

series.title: Are You Sure?
series.description: Follow the unpredictable and exciting journey of BTS's Jimin and Jung Kook!

series.title: True Beauty
series.description: Tired of being looked down upon for her unattractive appearance, middle schooler Lim Jugyeong turns to the transformative powers of makeup. First, she experiments with BB cream, lip tint, and eyeliner; then she begins using mascara, double eyelid glue, and colored contacts. Before she knows it, Jugyeong goes from being a girl who is bullied for her ugliness to being praised as a high-class beauty. Constantly surrounded by those who adore her goddess-like appearance, Jugyeong can now live a more than comfortable life at school—she simply has to keep her bare face a secret.  However, everything changes when the new transfer student, Lee Suho, enters her life. Not only does the handsome Suho become immediately popular among their peers, but in a chance encounter, he also becomes the only classmate of Jugyeong's to see her face beneath the makeup. With her reputation on the line, Jugyeong must do whatever it takes to hide the truth about her appearance from the rest of her classmates. But the more time she spends with Suho, the more Jugyeong finds herself questioning whether one's true beauty lies solely in their looks.

series.title: The Influencer
series.description: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram — 77 elite influencers flaunt their skills to strategically draw the most attention in this high-stakes social survival show.

series.title: Romance in the House
series.description: A drama depicting the story of imperfect humans meeting as a family and dreaming of perfect love.

series.title: Bad Memory Eraser
series.description: A nourishing romantic drama about a man whose life is changed with the eraser of bad memories and a woman who holds his fate.

series.title: Your Honor
series.description: The story of the forces that inherited wealth centered around the Woowon Group headquarters in the fictional Woowon City adjacent to the sea, the voodoo cartel that dominates the lawless area, and Judge Song Pan Ho, who comforts citizens seeking justice.

series.title: Resident Playbook
series.description: Set at the Jongno branch of Yulje Medical Center, the series follows the hospital lives and turbulent friendships of young obstetrics and gynecology residents who proudly enter the unpopular department in an era of low birth rates.

series.title: No Gain No Love
series.description: A comical romance between a woman who faked marriage because she didn't want to lose money and a man who became a fake groom because he didn't want to hurt a woman.

series.title: What Comes After Love
series.description: Five years have passed since Hong Yi has left Japan and Joon Go. Nearing thirty, Hong Yi works at her father's publishing firm and has spent the last few years trying to forget. But when Joon Go, now a famous writer, comes to Korea to promote his new book, Hong Yi confronts past memories of love, yearning, and heartbreak. When they finally meet, it's as if no time has passed at all. Both lovers are still trapped in old memories.

series.title: A-List to Playlist
series.description: With a 20-year acting career, Cho Jung Seok takes on the challenge of debuting as a singer in 100 days, mobilizing his entire network against the clock!

series.title: Cinderella at 2 AM
series.description: A drama about the love story of Ha Yoon Seo, a realist who believes that there is no Cinderella in reality, and Seo Joo Won, a romanticist who believes that conditions are not important in front of love.

series.title: Queen Woo
series.description: Upon the announcement of the king's death in Goguryeo, a fierce battle ensues among tribes. Queen Woo, who immediately becomes the target of princes and five tribes vying for the throne, struggles to crown a new king within 24 hours. Will Queen Woo be able to transcend the constraints of gender and era to carve out her own destiny?

series.title: Dear Hyeri
series.description: Ju Eun-ho is an unknown announcer with 14 years of experience. She struggles to get the chance to have her name recognized by the public. She also has another personality, Ju Hae-ri, due to a deep wound in her heart. Her alter-ego, Ju Hae-ri, is super positive and works as a parking attendant.     Jeong Hyun-oh is Ju Eun-ho's ex-boyfriend; they dated for a long time but broke up. He became a star announcer as soon as he joined the broadcasting station and is the most-liked announcer by the public, but Jeong Hyun-oh also carries a hidden wound in his mind that he has never shown to anyone. Somehow, Ju Eun-ho and Jeong Hyun-oh reunite and help cure each other's wounds.

series.title: Tempest
series.description: A former diplomat uncovers a conspiracy that threatens the stability of the Korean Peninsula.

series.title: The Judge from Hell
series.description: Kang Bit-na is a strikingly beautiful judge, but beneath her flawless exterior, she hides a dark secret — she is a demon. Her mission is to hunt down and kill evil people who lead other people to their deaths and don't reflect on their actions and are unforgivable. After executing her judgment, she condemns their souls to Hell. However, her life takes an unexpected turn when she encounters Han Da-on, a detective with a warm and gentle demeanor. As a detective, his mind is sharp and he has a keen sense of observation. Despite his outward kindness, Han Da-on harbors deep, unseen pain. Their meeting sets off a series of events that profoundly alters both of their lives.

series.title: Culinary Class Wars
series.description: From Michelin-star chefs to amateur cooks, 100 contestants don their knives for a culinary war where you won't guess what's coming next — or who'll win.

series.title: Seoul Busters
series.description: The nation's lowest ranking violent crimes squad and the most elite violent crimes team leader work together to become the strongest team.

series.title: The Trunk
series.description: A secret marriage service is uncovered when a trunk washes up on the shore, revealing the strange marriage between a couple in the thick of it all.

series.title: The Time of Fever
series.description: The story follows about two boys, Ho Tae and Dong Hee, who grow up together in Gangneung but are separated when Ho Tae moves to Seoul. After Dong Hee comes out to his family and is subsequently kicked out of his home, he finds refuge in Ho Tae's empty house. When Ho Tae returns to Gangneung for his father's funeral, the two reunite and begin living together, soon realizing that their feelings for each other have always gone beyond friendship or brotherhood.

series.title: Love in the Big City
series.description: An audacious tale of two roommates, one a homosexual man and another a heterosexual woman. Through the eyes of Mi Ae begins Go Yeong's clumsy love story. Stories of laughter, tears, and wounds between a mother in denial of his gender identity and a lover unable to escape societal judgment. Go Yeong finally meets a pure love like no other, Gyu Ho, but has no choice but to let him go. With Gyu Ho gone, Go Yeong follows a stranger to Thailand and spends a late monsoon vacation. Reminiscing about the good old days that can never be retrieved, he achieves complete personal growth.

series.title: Family By Choice
series.description: Yoon Ju-won is a bright, down-to-earth girl who lives with her single father, Yoon Jeong-jae, when Kim San-ha and Kang Hae-jun, two boys from complicated circumstances, come into her life. Her father takes in the boys to grow up together as a family. Despite being unrelated by blood, Ju-won adores San-ha and Hae-jun and thinks of them as her brothers, no matter how differently others think or say. They reunite after a decade apart - facing new dynamics, unresolved pain and the complexities of adulthood.

series.title: Jeongnyeon: The Star is Born
series.description: Jeong Nyeon has no money or education, but she is a Mokpo girl with a talent for singing! Her dream is to join a women's traditional theater company, and make it big. But she has a lot to learn and a long way to go before becoming a lead actor. Will Jeong Nyeon achieve her dream of becoming a big star and getting rich?

series.title: Iron Family
series.description: Cheongryeom Laundry has been run by Lee Da-Rim's family for 3 generations. Her family has enough money that they can iron out their dreams instead of being worried. Seo Kang-Joo is the son of the wealthiest family in the Cheongryeom neighborhood. He works as a senior director of the Jiseung Group. 8 years ago, Seo Kang-Joo and Lee Da-Rim attended the same university. Prior to enlisting in the military, he had an unforgettable experience with Lee Da-Rim.  Now, Seo Kang-Joo reunites with Lee Da-Rim and gets involved with her. Since she was in her teens, Lee Da-Rim's eyesight has deteriorated and she had limited vision. After turning 30 years old, Lee Da-Rim completely lost her vision, but there is hope that she will be able to see again. An injection that is extremely expensive may give her vision back.

series.title: A Virtuous Business
series.description: In search of purpose, opportunity and independence, four rural women start an adult products business in 1992 — embarking on a journey of self-discovery.

series.title: Comedy Revenge
series.description: Comedy icons, from YouTube stars to TV veterans, gather in the ultimate competition of laughter — to be crowned the winner by the legend, Lee Kyeong-kyu.

series.title: Doubt
series.description: Jang Tae Su is a legendary criminal profiler in Korea. He was one of the first in his field and paved the way for criminal behavior analysts in the country. He has gained the absolute respect and trust within the police organization. At home, he is a single parent and raises his daughter by himself. Jang Tae Su works on a murder case and realizes that his daughter is involved in the case. The discovery shakes everything in his professional beliefs and his relationship with his daughter. To protect his daughter, Jang Tae Su struggles to reveal the truth.

series.title: My Merry Marriage
series.description: By showing various aspects of marriage such as divorce, remarriage, and graduation, it asks about the true meaning of 'happiness'. A delightful family drama that will resonate and laughter across all generations.

series.title: Brewing Love
series.description: Chae Yong-ju is a former member of the special forces in the military. She's physically and mentally strong and has her own unique cheerfulness. She is also good at hiding her true emotions. Now working as a salesperson for a liquor company for the past six years, she has been dubbed the sales king. Despite her dedication, her branch is on the verge of closing. To avoid the closure, she carries out a mission to sell a new beer made by brewmaster & CEO of the brewery company, Yun Min-ju. Min-ju is a sensitive man good at sensing other people's emotions. He lives in a peaceful, quiet rural area to focus on making beer. When Yong-ju appears in front of him, however, his life is about to change.

series.title: Good Boy
series.description: A comical action youth investigative drama in which medalists who became police officers as special recruits from the Olympics wear police ID cards around their necks instead of medals and fight against a world rife with unscrupulousness and foul play.

series.title: Mr. Plankton
series.description: Lee Yoo Mi stars as a bride-to-be whose medical conditions threatens her marriage to a family obsessed with continuing their grand lineage.

series.title: Cashero
series.description: An ordinary man who inherits super strength discovers a greater evil out to steal his power. The one catch? Every use drains money from his wallet.

series.title: Genie, Make a Wish
series.description: A woman becomes the master of a genie who keeps tempting her to make a wish — sparking a risky, magical connection.

series.title: Can This Love Be Translated?
series.description: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

series.title: The Price of Confession
series.description: Accused of killing her husband, a woman is offered a way out by a mysterious stranger: in exchange for a confession in her place, she must commit murder.

series.title: Good or Bad Dong Jae
series.description: Seo Dong Jae is a prosecutor and works in the Cheongju District Prosecutors' Office. He is ambitious and places a priority on his success as a prosecutor. Nevertheless, he is not completely cold hearted as a person. Due to the label given to him as a corrupt prosecutor, his future as a prosecutor is not bright at all. While mired in trouble over a redevelopment case, he takes on a high school student murder case. He begins to walk a fine line between his intuition as a prosecutor and instinct as an opportunist.  This is a spin-off of "Stranger" (2017) drama.

series.title: Our Beautiful Summer
series.description: The story of A Reum, Da Un, Yu Ri and our three siblings who were born as quadruplets and lost the youngest, Na Ra, and became three, and the lonely summer when no one was there, meeting and falling in love again and becoming happy.

series.title: Love Your Enemy
series.description: A reunion romance that takes place over 15 years when two men and women, who loved each other passionately when they were in school but had to make a painful breakup due to antagonism between families and the mischief of fate, meet again.

series.title: The Tale of Lady Ok
series.description: A work that contains the fierce survival and success of a female slave during the Joseon Dynasty, and depicts the story of a woman whose name, status, and even her husband are fake.

series.title: Rap:Public
series.description: RAP:PUBLIC invites you to a hip-hop survival world you have never seen before. It's a real hip-hop survival show where the participants compete and survive using rap as their weapon. The rappers form their own 'blocks' and compete as a team to survive in a society disconnected from the outside world. In this society where cooperation and competition coexist, they can only decide their fate through games that use rap. The final winning block will be given 300,000 dollars as a prize and become the first owner of RAP:PUBLIC.

series.title: Marry You
series.description: Level seven government worker Jung Ha-na's dream is to retire peacefully, but her feisty attitude lands her in the Marriage Promotion Team at Injeong City Hall, a role she finds baffling as she doesn't believe in marriage herself. To make matters worse, her ex-boyfriend Ki-jun, whom she nearly married three years ago, appears as her new team leader, adding to her disbelief. Desperate to escape the team, Ha-na is tasked with marrying off local bachelor Cheol-hee. Though Cheol-hee initially refuses, believing he's not suited for marriage, Ha-na's determination gradually softens his heart. As they open up to each other, Ha-na and Cheol-hee, who both doubted their worthiness of marriage, find themselves questioning if they can take the plunge after all. Will Ha-na and Cheol-hee finally gather the courage to believe in love and marriage?

series.title: Face Me
series.description: A medical mystery thriller that traces the truth of the incident of a famous plastic surgeon, who had a reputation as a righteous man, who fell into the abyss after being caught up in an unexpected incident and underwent reconstructive plastic surgery for crime victims.

series.title: Parole Examiner Lee
series.description: Parole Examiner Lee  follows lawyer Lee Han Shin, who becomes a parole officer responsible for making final decisions on inmate paroles. Lee Han Shin is determined to prevent inmates who show little remorse for their crimes from obtaining paroles through money, connections, or deceitful tactics.

series.title: Family Planning
series.description: A group of people possessing special abilities disguise themselves as a family to survive against heinous criminals. Han Yeong Su is a loving mother with a special ability. Baek Cheol Hui is a father who hides his special ability. He has a timid personality, but he loves his wife, Yeong Su, a lot. Baek Gang Seong is a grandfather who shows an abrupt manner, but he cares for his family a lot. Baek Ji Hun and Baek Ji U are 17-year-old brother and sister. Ji Hun has a warm and gentle personality, while Ji U is picky and sensitive.

series.title: Hyper Knife
series.description: Jung Se Ok, a formerly successful neurosurgeon who works as a shadow doctor in an underground surgery clinic after being expelled by her mentor, Choi Duk Hee. Soon, both doctors reunite, reigniting a tense and emotional rivalry.

series.title: Sorry Not Sorry
series.description: Dumped overnight, Ji Song Yi is left burdened by the difficulties of single life, part-time jobs, and paying off her newlywed home loan. She keeps up the ruse of being a happily married woman to save herself from being estranged from the married townswomen.

series.title: Way Back Love
series.description: The Grim Reaper appears as the person you love the most before you die. In front of 24-year-old Hee Wan who had no will to carry on and lived as a social outcast, her childhood friend as well as her first love Ram Woo appears as a Grim Reaper and tells her she will die in a week. Hee Wan and Ram Woo are forced to spend a week together. Throughout their time together, they rediscover the meaning of life and reconnect with what truly matters.

series.title: The WONDERfools
series.description: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

series.title: Check in Hanyang
series.description: A drama about Yongcheonru, the largest guest inn of Joseon, with the unspoken value 'guests are kings', and the Joseon flower youths who joined the company as educational envoys who were hired by the government office to do small things.

series.title: Who Is She
series.description: A romantic music coming-of-age drama about grandmother Oh Mal Soon, who turns into a 20-year-old Oh Doo Ri overnight and enjoys her shining prime once again.

series.title: Namib
series.description: After being fired for her past mistakes, former entertainment company CEO Kang Soo-hyun is offered a severance package to buy out her longtime trainee, Yoo Jin-woo. Soo-hyun decides to train Jin-woo well and sell him to another company so that she can buy a factory for her disabled child. At first, she only thinks of her own child and tries to make Jin-woo successful, but as time goes by, she helps him sincerely.

series.title: Love Scout
series.description: A successful and confident woman, Kang Ji Yun, is the CEO of a headhunting company. To survive in the fiercely competitive headhunting field, she puts everything she has into her work. Outside of her job, she doesn't know how to do anything. She has a secretary named Yoo Eun Ho who takes care of pretty much everything for her. Unlike his boss, the secretary is friendly, well-mannered, and considerate of other people. He is a single father, who is also good at parenting and housework.

series.title: JUNG KOOK: I AM STILL > THE ORIGINAL
series.description: In the 2020s, JUNG KOOK emerged as a top solo artist. He won over audiences with chart-topping hits like "Seven," "3D," and "Standing Next to You." To this day, he still gives his all to make ARMY proud, and is constantly striving to improve and evolve. Instead of resting on his laurels with his natural talent and impressive career, he continues to blaze his own trail. From his solo career launch single to the promotion of his album GOLDEN, experience eight months of Jung Kook's golden life as he travels the globe, visiting cities like New York, London, and Seoul. This is the story of Jung Kook, an artist who never stops dreaming.

series.title: Cinderella Game
series.description: A woman was used as a fake daughter by her enemy and became the embodiment of revenge. She grows and heals as she realizes the true meaning of revenge.

series.title: Motel California
series.description: Ji Gang Hui grew up at Motel California because her father ran the motel in her rural hometown village. Her mother also came from a mixed-raced background. Due to Gang Hui's unusual family background, she was the object of whispers and gossip by the local residents. Gang Hui carried a deep wound in her heart from that time. She liked her childhood friend Cheon Yeon Su, who was her first love, but when she turned 20, she left her hometown and moved to Seoul. 12 years later, she works as an interior designer and is reaching the apex of her career, but, for some reason, she decides to return to her hometown. She reunites with her first love, Cheon Yeon Su. Cheon Yeon Su works as a veterinarian in the village. The only woman he has loved is Gang Hui, but he has received a lot of attention from the farmers who are eager to introduce him to their daughters. In order to avoid these kind of uncomfortable situations, he doesn't clarify the rumor that he is going to marry a fellow veterinarian. His first love Gang Hui appears again after 12 years.

series.title: The Witch
series.description: Dong Jin is recognized as the best in the field of data mining. The reason he majored in statistics at his university was because of Mi Jung and his wish to help her. Dong Jin and Mi Jung attended the same high school and he had crush on her, but she was called a witch. Since Mi Jung was little, strange things occurred around her like all the guys who liked her died or got injured. 10 years after school graduation, Dong Jin happens to meet Mi Jung again. She has now cut herself off from the world, believing her fate is cursed, but she wants to go out into the world. In hopes of Mi Jung breaking out of her shell, Dong in wants to prove that all these unfortunate incidents are not because of her. To prove his thesis, he investigates all the situations when guys around her got hurt. Risking his life, he finally finds the law of misfortune around her.

series.title: The Queen Who Crowns
series.description: Queen Won Kyung, born to Min Je during the Goryeo period, came from a prestigious family of high-ranking officials. Married to Lee Bang Won, son of King Taejo, she supported her husband's ambitions to become King Taejong after his father bypassed him for the throne. As a kingmaker, she helped establish a new regime. However, their relationship soured after Lee Bang Won became king, took concubines, and sought to curb Queen Won Kyung's influence and that of her family.

series.title: Trigger
series.description: An action thriller drama that depicts what happens when guns of unknown origin are unleashed in South Korea, a gun-free country, and guns are given to angry people one by one.

series.title: Perfect Crown
series.description: Welcome to 21st-century Korea, a constitutional monarchy where tradition and modernity intertwine in style, and glamour masks a rigid social hierarchy. Seong Huiju, a brilliant chaebol heiress and CEO, seems to have everything. Yet as a commoner by birth, she is always denied the respect she deserves. When her family begins relentlessly pushing her toward future marriage prospects, Huiju grows determined to take control of her own future after she crosses paths with Grand Prince lan at the Imperial Birthday Banquet. She has everything but status, whereas he has nothing but status. Together, they enter a contract marriage of the century. But can they break societal barriers and carve out their own destinies?

series.title: Rugged Rugby: Conquer or Die
series.description: In the shadows of Korea's rugby world, seven teams engage in a fierce battle of strength, strategy, and teamwork — all vying to be crowned champion.

series.title: Newtopia
series.description: Set in an air defense unit in a high-rise building in Seoul, the drama depicts the process of a soldier, Jae-yoon, and his girlfriend, Yeong-joo, who have just been notified of a breakup, running toward each other while fighting a horde of zombies.

series.title: Oh My Ghost Clients
series.description: Mu-jin is a labor attorney who gets paid for covering up the corruption of problematic companies while visiting labor sites with high industrial accident risks. One day, during an inspection of a factory, he faces a near-death crisis when steel materials collapse. At that moment, a Bodhisattva with a burning labor law book in hand appears before Mu-jin and forces him to sign a labor contract. Then, Mu-jin gains the ability to see ghosts, and to save his own life he also must solve various labor problems brought by the ghosts and resolve their grudges.

series.title: Study Group
series.description: It follows the life of student Yoon Ga Min, who wants to be good at studying but is only good at fighting, as he forms a study group at the worst school on earth and tells a fierce story about college entrance exams. Yoon Ga Min, who looks like a model student but is a student of Yusung Technical High School, which is one of the worst schools to study at. Although he studies extremely hard, his grades don't rise in the slightest. Despite all that, Yoon Ga Min sits diligently at his desk with the goal of going to college. However, when his study group friends get bullied, Yoon Ga Min takes off his glasses and school uniform jacket to put his fighting skills to use. Lee Han Kyeong, Yoon Ga Min's teacher, dreams of seeing the school change for the better. Lee Han Kyeong tutored Yoon Ga Min during her university days and reunites with him when she is appointed as a temporary teacher, holding a secret.

series.title: Nine Puzzles
series.description: After discovering the body of her murdered uncle, Yoon Ena becomes a profiler to uncover the truth behind what happened that night. A decade later, Detective Hansaem still suspects Ena was responsible, and when a series of murders begins to occur, each linked to a corresponding puzzle piece, Hansaem will follow his instincts to track down the killer.

series.title: The Scandal of Chunhwa
series.description: Set in the fictional country of Dongbangguk. Hwari is youngest princess of the royal family. She grew up with an independent mindset. When she reaches the age to marry, she decides to find her husband by herself. She comes out of the palace to meet her suitors. She also tries to find the person who painted her face as the main female character in a series of erotic chunhwa paintings.  Meanwhile, Choi Hwan is first on the list of potential husbands for Princess Hwari. He is the wealthiest merchant and possesses a handsome appearance. He looks like a man who enjoys women and money, but he seems to hide a secret.

series.title: Made in Korea
series.description: In 1970s South Korea a man determined to reach the pinnacle of wealth and power lives a double life - KCIA agent by day and dangerous business man by night. Determined and unstoppable, he comes face to face with a tenacious prosecutor willing to risk it all to bring him down.

series.title: Buried Hearts
series.description: To survive, a man hacked into a political slush fund worth 2 trillion won. The other man is a powerful shadowy figure, who loses 2 trillion won by killing a man without knowing that he was hacked.

series.title: Low Life
series.description: A man and his uncle are offered to find a bowl relic in the West Sea, and they jump into a treasure hunt to escape from their lives of selling fakes. As more and more people search for the treasure, their obsessions become mad and they are forced to make choices between desire and humanity.

series.title: The Murky Stream
series.description: A gripping tale of twisted fates unfolds in lawless Joseon, where the once-pristine Gyeonggang River has turned into a murky stream. Jang Si Yul, a man who buries his past to survive as a gangster, Choi Eun, a sharp-minded and righteous soul, and Jung Chun, an idealist striving to become an honest official, find their destinies entangled in a world where justice is scarce, and survival comes at a cost.

series.title: The Haunted Palace
series.description: Born with shamanic powers that she refuses to accept, a young woman confronts her gift to rid the Joseon palace of evil spirits and save her first love.

series.title: The Art of Negotiation
series.description: Yoon Joo-no, a key figure in the former M&A Team of SANIN GROUP, suddenly disappeared one day, leaving for Hawaii for undisclosed reasons. Rumors spread that he had been demoted, but the truth remains unknown to anyone. Then, three years later, when SANIN GROUP is facing bankruptcy with 11 billion dollars in debt, he is called back to Korea as their last hope. His mission is clear: to save SANIN GROUP. However, his solution is far from straightforward. Gaining the support of CEO Song Jae-sik, he forms a new M&A Team and gathers the best negotiators to dive into the perilous world of high-stakes deals. With his team, Joo-no takes one last gamble. Can he secure the 11 billion dollars needed to save the company, or will even the so-called "god of negotiation" be brought down?

series.title: Knock Off
series.description: Kim Seong-Jun (Kim Soo-Hyun) is regular office worker, but, after the IMF crisis, he lost his job and began working the counterfeit market. He begins to work as the vice chairman of a counterfeit producing company and grows the company into one of the largest counterfeiters in the world. He relies on his intelligence, quick response to unexpected situations, and a strong desire for success to become the king of the counterfeit market.  Meanwhile, Song Hye-Jeong (Jo Bo-Ah) is Kim Seong-Jun's ex-girlfriend and she works as a special judicial police officer, whose job is to crack down on counterfeit goods. Kim Seong-Jun and Song Hye-Jeong form a tense relationship surrounding the crackdown of counterfeit goods.

series.title: Walking on Thin Ice
series.description: A human thriller that takes place when a housewife in her 40s with a sick husband accidentally picks up drugs that fell on the road.

series.title: Queen Mantis
series.description: A thriller that follows a woman who was imprisoned as a serial killer a long time ago, and someone begins a serial killing imitating her.

series.title: My Dearest Nemesis
series.description: As a high school senior, Su-Jeong began playing an online game where she met another player nicknamed "Black Dragon". They unexpectedly got close, developing crushes and planning a meeting in real life… that concluded in humiliation and disaster when "Black Dragon" turned out to be an awkward middle schooler instead of the young man he portrayed himself to be! Sixteen years later, Su-Jeong is a skilled planner at Yongseong Department Store, but her job is about to get a shakeup with the arrival of Ban Ju-Yeon, the ambitious new head of strategic planning and heir to the company. There's just one problem: Ban Ju-Yeon is actually "Black Dragon", and Su-Jeong still holds a grudge. Will their past come back to haunt them, or can they find a way to resolve their misunderstandings – and even find love as adults?

series.title: The Potato Lab
series.description: In  The Potato Lab , Mi Kyung's potato-centric life is upended by Baek Ho, a cold pragmatist. A whirlwind healing romantic comedy unfolds, as twisty as a tornado potato.

series.title: Melo Movie
series.description: Even if hardship and misfortune always accompany life, the youths who have walked with their middle finger raised now seek someone to lean on wholeheartedly, wanting to find a person to rely on as if they were to fall. Dreaming of becoming a film director one day, Kim Moo Bi, an assistant director, wants to follow in her father's footsteps, who worked as a filming crew member. After entering the film industry, she quietly honed her skills, not drawing attention to herself in the eyes of others. On the other hand, Ko Gyeom rose from being a supporting actor to becoming a film critic. He meets Moo Bi on the set of an interview film, eventually starting their own love story.

series.title: FC Soldout
series.description: FC Soldout  is about a soccer team that is not doing well, one day it is bought by a agency, the reason for the acquisition is just to commoditize the team to make money again, the agency takes over and cuts out all the players with poor face，then forces the actors with face value from their agency to become players.

series.title: Kick Kick Kick Kick
series.description: A comedy-drama about a star story that takes place in establishing and running a new content production company by an entertainment producer and a once-popular actor.

series.title: Friendly Rivalry
series.description: Woo Seul-Ki grew up in an orphanage out in a province. She moves to Seoul and enrolls in Chaehwa High School, which is a school for the top 1% students in South Korea. Woo Seul-Ki doesn't get along with the other students. A student named Yoo Je-Yi approaches her and they become friends.  Yoo Je-Yi is the most powerful student in the school. She has a high IQ, comes from a wealthy family background, and is attractive physically. She has lived as the envy of other people since she was born and she is aware of her superiority. She is also cunning enough to know how to take advantage of her position. She shows special interest in transfer student Woo Seul-Ki. They soon develop a dangerous relationship between friendship and obsession.

series.title: The Queen Who Crowns: Before Sunrise
series.description: A romance drama depicting the fateful first meeting between 'Won Kyung', who dreamed of a new world before embracing the world, and 'Bang Won', who shared the same aspirations as her.

series.title: EXchange: Another Beginning
series.description: The beloved casts from the hit reality series — EXchange: Seasons 1, 2, and 3 — reunite for an exciting new chapter! This spin-off focuses on new dynamics, unexpected connections, and captivating chemistry as past participants embark on thrilling journeys together. Centered around travel and friendships, the show promises heartfelt moments and unforgettable experiences.

series.title: Mother and Mom
series.description: The life of a three-generation mother-daughter in Daechi-dong, where Jung Eun, an avid working mother, prepares for her daughter's '7th birthday' and entrusts Ji Ah to drive her to school.

series.title: Our Chocolate Moments
series.description: Seul Gi gets a job at a chocolate shop and, no matter how hard she tries, she can't seem to adapt to the environment. Despite trying to overcome her alienation with positivity, she always ends up getting hurt. One day, at Honggeumdang, a place she visited to fix a broken watch, Seul Gi falls in love with the charm of whiskey and artisanal chocolate. With this in mind, she becomes the only member of a task force that will participate in an internal Valentine's Day contest. She starts collaborating with the owner of Honggeumdang to create the best chocolate ever, but ends up having trouble finding teammates. That's when Hyun Nam, a chocolate freak, and Jeremy, an outgoing influencer, show up. Now, this trio and Mr. Hong, who is nice in a weird way, will have the chance to create the best Valentine's Day chocolate.

series.title: The Divorce Insurance
series.description: A drama that contains the explicit process of putting a value on divorce, such as developing a new divorce insurance product by an insurance company's innovative product development team, which is comprised of only the best brains, quantifying all matters related to divorce and determining the appropriate insurance amount.

series.title: Villains Everywhere
series.description: A family comedy situation drama about middle-aged K-sisters, their husbands, and their children living together in a world overflowing with villains.

series.title: The Good Man
series.description: Seok-cheol, the eldest son in a family of three generations of gangsters, navigates the tumultuous ups and downs of life with tears and laughter, all to protect his family, career, and love.

series.title: Screwballs
series.description: Five siblings face endless missions in this pure entertainment variety show. With a few screws loose, they embrace chaos in their search for sanity.

series.title: Crushology 101
series.description: If there were a guide for love, would Bunny not have been a pushover? Although she is crazy over good looks, Bunny believes sincerity is more important when dating. The result? Her first love with terrible looks and an awful personality turns out to be the worst, and she becomes known as a school-wide pushover. With the determination to never fail again, Bunny declares she will no longer act like a doormat and only date alpha males when four outstanding oppas appear before her. Bunny's heart gets no rest amid the endless parade of high-quality flirting, aimed to win her over and become her number one oppa. Is this a guide to stop being a pushover? Or is it a proper dating course for falling in love? Will Bunny the pushover transform into a dating genius?

series.title: 24 Health Club
series.description: Do Hyeon-joong was once the star of "Mr. David," the premier bodybuilding competition in the U.S.—until he vanished without a trace. Now he's running a shabby 24-hour gym. After a terrible first night with her boyfriend, followed by an even worse breakup, Mi-ran signs up for Hyeon-joong's expensive personal-training plan, desperate to reboot her life. As Mi-ran fights to get fit and find herself again, Hyeon-joong's own world heads in unexpected directions. Can Hyun-joong prove himself as a rookie gym owner, and will Mi-ran rediscover her spark? Their sweaty, heart-warming reboot begins now.

series.title: Heart Pairing
series.description: They're young and serious about love — meet the singles looking to marry. With the MCs' help, couples hope to find a lifelong partnership.

series.title: Business as Unusual
series.description: Kim Minjun is your average 30-year-old office worker. Now that he's older, Minjun is feeling the pressure to accomplish more in life, and he can't shake the feeling that something is missing amidst the monotonous routine of his 9-to-5 job. Out of nowhere, his ex-boyfriend Jinhwan shows up as a new co-worker, looking as handsome and charismatic as ever while Minjun feels like he hasn't progressed at all since their breakup 10 years ago. Determined not to let an ex from a decade ago mess with his work life, Minjun just wants to carry on with business as usual. But it seems that Jinhwan has other plans in mind…

series.title: Law and the City
series.description: A cheerful and passionate youth drama about associate lawyers who go to work at Seocho-dong Law Town every day. It is a realistic story of 'real' lawyers who have stepped into the real world and will portray the coming of age of lawyers in charge of cases that can happen in and around our daily lives. An Ju Hyeong is a 9th-year lawyer with a high level of fact-violence logic. He became a lawyer simply because he found logic and cases interesting. From the beginning, he did not have the 'meaning' that lawyers protect the weak, implement justice, and change the world. He is just a 9th office worker. He has been a regular at the same company for 9 years without changing jobs, and his work is at its peak as his seniority. He is a veteran in the associate industry who has set a new associate salary record but does not open a practice because it is too much trouble. For Ju Hyeong, the peaceful wall of the 'workplace' begins to crack. Kang Hui Ji is a 2nd-year lawyer at Johwa Law Firm. She believes that " if you change one person's life, you have changed that person's world." Whether she is lacking or overflowing, she is confident and honest.

series.title: Teach You a Lesson
series.description: When respect collapses in schools, a special unit arrives to set things right — with sharp, no-nonsense lessons you won't find in textbooks.

series.title: Heavenly Ever After
series.description: Upon arriving in heaven at the age of 80, Hae Sook reunites with her rejuvenated husband, Nak Joon, leading to a romance that transcends their earthly lives.

series.title: Kian's Bizarre B&B
series.description: On a remote island, Kian84 hosts a quirky B&B escape, where BTS' Jin and Ji Ye-eun lead guests through playful exploits and delightful chaos.

series.title: Unbelievable Space Love
series.description: Gazing at the scenic view of the sky, a man is joined by a stranger who informs him that he is in a dream. Unable to recall the memories of his life, he relies on the visitor to take him on a journey of discovery. Revealing everything—from their seven-year relationship to the emotional hardships they faced together—the two rekindle their bond severed by time.
