Behind this beautiful love story, however, lies a much darker truth.

series.title: Twelve
series.description: Inspired by the 12 zodiac animals of the East,  Twelve  tells the story of 12 angels living in the human world in human form to protect the Korean Peninsula from evil spirits. Long ago, the angels barely managed to seal the forces of evil in the gates of hell through their sacrifice, bringing peace. However, with the evil spirits awakening, chaos returns.

series.title: Partner's Territory
series.description: An irresistible rough romance between three men who invade each other's realm. Lee Je-jae and Shin Jin-gi have been separated and reunited. He now lives with Shin Jin-gi, a married man who is married by contract, but he remembers the selfish Shin Jin-ki who said he was not a homosexual and told him to stop. Meanwhile, a new owner Lee Cheok appears in front of Lee Yi Je, who works as a manager at Soul Brush, and Shin Jin Ki complains about his charismatic appearance.

series.title: Moon River
series.description: Joseon Crown Prince Lee Gang is known by many as an unserious, pleasure-seeking man, but he uses this facade to mask his deep pain from losing his beloved wife. While his mother tries to find him a new spouse, he's dismissive of her attempts, only wishing to pursue revenge. His life takes a turn when he runs into Park Dal I, a merchant with amnesia who bears a startling resemblance to his wife. Although Dal I and Lee Gang's first meeting goes poorly, they soon find themselves as unlikely allies helping those in need. However, the two awaken one morning to the shock of a lifetime: they've swapped bodies. As Lee Gang and Dal I try to figure out how this happened, they uncover political conspiracies and dangerous secrets – and that their connection might run deeper than they think.

series.title: Second Shot at Love
series.description: A story about a woman who was born and raised in a family of alcoholics escaping from her drunkenness.   Han Geum Joo is a mechanic who becomes a public servant at a large company because she loves cars. She was called a "woman who drinks better than men," but when she is given another title of "alcoholic," Geum Joo decides to challenge herself by "abstaining from drinking." Seo Ui Joon is a doctor who was on a roll as a specialist at a prestigious university hospital in Seoul but ended up moving down to the rural village of Bocheon Health Center. He believes that alcohol is not a cure but an anesthetic and can ruin your life, and he will likely get involved with Geum Joo, who has been given the title of "alcoholic".

series.title: Tastefully Yours
series.description: Tastefully Yours d epicts the story of Han Bum Woo, the successor of a large food company, who runs the best fine dining restaurant in Seoul but has no interest in 'taste', and Mo Yun Joo, a chef crazy about 'taste' who runs a one-table restaurant without a sign in a remote corner of the countryside. They grow together and fall in love while running a small restaurant in the city of Miraek, Jeonju.

series.title: Crowd Control
series.description: The improvised stand-up show where the audience is the material.

series.title: Young Dan'l Boone
series.description: Young Dan'l Boone  is a western series about an American frontiersman, Daniel Boone, during his earlier years. The series follows Boone and his three companions (Peter Dawes, Hawk and a Cherokee named Tsiskwa) on his adventures. Daniel Boone became one of the first great American folk heroes. As a young man. his adventures took place in the turbulent years when the American colonies were fighting for their independence.

series.title: Perry Mason
series.description: Perry Mason is an attorney who specializes in defending seemingly indefensible cases. With the aid of his secretary Della Street and investigator Paul Drake, he often finds that by digging deeply into the facts, startling facts can be revealed. Often relying on his outstanding courtroom skills, he often tricks or traps people into unwittingly admitting their guilt.

series.title: Getaway
series.description: Getaway  is Australia's favourite travel show with wonderful holiday ideas for all tastes and budgets as well as those once in a lifetime, dream destinations. Escape today with  Getaway .

series.title: Baddies USA
series.description: OG's hit the road across the USA with packed concerts, camaraderie and chaos.

series.title: Lucky
series.description: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life — and a way out.

series.title: Elliott from Earth
series.description: Elliott from Earth  is a comedy animated series about a young boy who finds himself living on a gigantic spaceship, with all sorts of aliens from around the universe. It's a show about finding your place in the world, even if it's in outer space. Oh, and his best friend is a dinosaur.

series.title: CBS Weekend News
series.description: CBS Weekend News  offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

series.title: HexVets and Magic Pets
series.description: In  HexVets and Magic Pets , kid witches Annette and Clarion are thrilled to become HexVet apprentices to the kind, clever, and sometimes cheeky Dr. Talon. At her clinic, they learn how to heal and care for magical creatures while picking up some important social-emotional lessons themselves.  Annette and Clarion are unlikely friends that couldn't be more different - she's all drive and he leads with his heart - but through their comical adventures, they find they're stronger together.  Part magical procedural, part creature comedy, and all heart,  HexVets and Magic Pets  is a series about persisting after failure, celebrating differences, and bringing all the magic you can into the world.

series.title: Adventure Time: Side Quests
series.description: Adventure awaits young hero Finn and his magical dog best friend Jake as they quest to party with cloud people and punch evil's butt across the epic, fantastical land of OOO.

series.title: 100 Days of Deception
series.description: Set in Gyeongseong during the Japanese colonial period, the drama follows Ga Gyeong, the city's most talented pickpocket, who strikes a dangerous deal with the independence army and goes undercover at the Japanese Government-General of Joseon. Disguised as an employee, she is tasked with acting as a "fake spy" for just 100 days, but her mission slowly turns her into a real informant caught between survival, loyalty, and conviction.

series.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White
series.description: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

series.title: Spring of Youth
series.description: A musical youth drama where a top K-pop star named Sa Gye is forced to attend a university campus, forming a four-member co-ed band, loving passionately, and growing through music.

series.title: Our Unwritten Seoul
series.description: Our Unwritten Seoul  centers on twin sisters, Yoo Mi Ji and Yoo Mi Rae — identical in appearance yet opposite in personality and life paths. After a complicated twist of fate, they swap identities, each sister navigating unfamiliar challenges to discover love and their true selves.

series.title: The First Night with the Duke
series.description: A handsome, selfish noble falls for a beautiful, kind commoner -- at least, that's how the story's supposed to go. When an average college student wakes up as Cha Sun Chaek, an extra in her favorite romance novel, she resolves to enjoy the luxuries of her character's status while watching the novel's plot unfold from the sidelines.  However, her plans are soon derailed when she finds herself in bed with no other than Lee Bun, the novel's hero! Dodging the villainess' schemes, the Duke's advances, and her own feelings, can Sun Chaek keep the story on track and survive beyond the first night?

series.title: The Colors of Our Time
series.description: It tells the romance of Yu Ra a web novel writer who planed her new romance novel when she saw by chance the photographer Jung Woo but ended up being the main character of the story.

series.title: Dead-End Job
series.description: Dead-End Job  follows, a young man who takes on a seemingly perfect part-time job offering 50 times the usual hourly wage through a mysterious employment agency called Spyder Human Resource Center. However, the job quickly becomes a nightmare as he encounters strange and terrifying phenomena.

series.title: ONE: High School Heroes
series.description: A school action drama that depicts the story of a model student who once dedicated all his attention to studying but finds himself entangled in domestic violence and school bullying, compelling him to make a transformative decision. "High School Heroes" pertains to a group formed by the main characters who stand up against school violence perpetrators on behalf of the victims.

series.title: A Head Coach's Turnover
series.description: Maeng Gong is the coach of the professional basketball team ‘Big Pandas', which has been on the verge of elimination from the playoffs for three consecutive years. Due to poor performance, he is in danger of being fired. When he was young, he was a star player who attacked boldly on the court, as his name suggests, but now he is more famous as the ‘Young Gong Dae' coaching a professional basketball team.  Ko Hwa Jin, a dedicated hater of Maeng Gong, works under the nickname ‘Maeng Gong Extermination Group'. He is a high school student who knows how to analyze the game in seconds. He is a character who has become a malicious commenter, full of hostility and a desire to get revenge on Maeng Gong.  With his job on the line, Maeng Gong decides to work with his malicious commenter to achieve team results.

series.title: The Hunter With a Scalpel
series.description: Seo Se-Hyun is a genius forensic pathologist. While examining a corpse, she discovers traces of her father Yoon Jo-Kyun who is a serial killer. She desperately attempts to track down her father Yoon Jo-Kyun with Jung Jung-Hyun. He is the chief of the violent crimes team.

series.title: Pro Bono
series.description: The story of Kang Da Wit, a successful judge with exceptional work efficiency and quick thinking, but he is also materialistic and obsessed with success. One day, he faces an unexpected crisis and, against his will, becomes a public defender.

series.title: Head Over Heels
series.description: Park Seong A is a high school student, but, at night, she is a shaman named Fairy Cheon Ji. When she works as a shaman, she covers her face partially to hide her identity. She is famous as Fairy Cheon Ji and she is busy working with her clients who come to ask about their future, fortune, illnesses, and other things. One night, Bae Gyeon U and his mother come to visit Fairy Cheon Ji. Park Seong A has a crush on him at first sight, but she sees that he is destined to die soon. The next day, Bae Gyeon U appears in front of her as a new transfer student in her class. She decides to save him from his destiny.

series.title: Our Movie
series.description: The story of a film director suffering from a Sophomore jinx and a time-limited actor who wants to live as the main character of his life only at the end of his life.

series.title: Salon de Holmes
series.description: There is never a quiet day at Gwangseon Jugong Apartments! From noise complaints and suspicious neighbors to the petty villains who drive everyone mad, the incidents are non-stop. Fed up, four women join forces: Gong Miri, a sharp-eyed deduction specialist; Choo Kyungja, a former detective whose fists move faster than the law; Park Sohee, the ultimate neighborhood informant; and Jeon Jihyun, a former insurance sales star who knows everyone's business. As a single unit, they tackle the complex's chaos with a flawless division of labor. What begins as investigations into mundane apartment life soon spirals out of control, revealing shocking missing links. Joined by laughter and fierce loyalty, this unstoppable "womance" team is ready for action!

series.title: The Manipulated
series.description: A blood-red revenge drama in which a man who was living normally returns from hell when his life suddenly falls into abyss one day.

series.title: I'd Rather Quit Than Die, Director!
series.description: Jinwoo Seo, who died in an accident after being sidelined at work, suddenly wakes up in the past?! He's returned to the time before his idea was stolen and decides to quit… But when Executive Director Baek Eui-hyeon says just one thing, he ends up becoming the project lead instead!

series.title: Ippon! : Hold Me Tight
series.description: A man who dreamed of becoming a national judo representative, Jun-woo, is defeated in a single match by Min-jae, who appeared like a comet.

series.title: Better Late Than Single
series.description: Ready to step into the dating world, lifelong singles get expert help for style, health and confidence. Will they manage hiccups on their way to love?

series.title: Bon Appétit, Your Majesty
series.description: What happens when a Michelin-worthy chef from Paris accidentally time-slips to the Joseon dynasty? She meets the King, a fearsome tyrant with an unexpectedly refined palate. In a bid to survive palace intrigue and royal appetites, she whips up dazzling fusion dishes that tempt even the coldest heart. But as sparks fly in the royal kitchen, a slow-burn romance simmers beneath the surface.

series.title: The East Palace
series.description: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

series.title: As You Stood By
series.description: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.

series.title: Mary Kills People
series.description: Based on a Canadian series, this dark comedy is the story of a doctor who is illegally helping terminally ill patients end their life, and a detective who is investigating these illegal activities.

series.title: S Line
series.description: Suddenly red lines appear above people's head. These red lines connect people who have had sex relations. Due to this, embarrassing or secret sides of people are revealed. People call these red lines "S Line."  Han Ji-Wook (Lee Soo-Hyuk) is a detective with an attractive appearance and free spirit. He chases after the truth of the S Line. Kyu-Jin (Lee Da-Hee) is a high school teacher with unique charm. Hyun-Hob (Arin) is a high school student. She has been able to see the red lines since she was born.

series.title: The Defects
series.description: ‘The Defects' is an action thriller depicting the desperate survival and revenge of children who barely survived on the brink of death after being abandoned by their adoptive parents.

series.title: Lead Male Character Search
series.description: Oh Seol-Rem was the top student in her grade year at her high school. She got addicted to an online game and failed to enter a university. She is now studying to take her university entrance exam after graduating from high school. She met a male character Tarakexcali in the online game and fell in love with Tarakexcali. She never met him in real life and didn't know anything about him except that he attends Ganghan University. They even promised to marry, but one day, he suddenly disappeared from the online game. She unplugs her computer and studies hard. Finally, Oh Seol-Rem enters Ganghan University where the male character Tarakexcali is attending in real life. She looks around for Tarakexcali.

series.title: My Girlfriend Is the Man!
series.description: Yunjae Park thought his relationship with his girlfriend, Ji-eun, was perfect--until one shocking morning changed everything. Ji-eun has mysteriously transformed into a man overnight! Can the two adjust to this sudden and earth-shattering change? And will Ji-eun ever turn back to who she once was?!

series.title: Beyond the Bar
series.description: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

series.title: SKZ Code
series.description: Reality show web series by South Korean boy group Stray Kids. It features the group taking part in different games and activities.

series.title: The Winning Try
series.description: Joo Ka-Ram used to be a rugby player who was the hope for Korean rugby. He had talent and star potential, but a drug scandal ruined everything. All of the sports media covered his drug scandal. He retired from the sport under the stigma of a drug addict. 3 years later, he returns as a contract coach for the high school rugby team where he once played for. The high school rugby team is the weakest team in its league. As a coach, Joo Ka-Ram shows unrivaled charisma and an uncompromising leadership ability. He also reunites with his ex-girlfriend Bae Yi-Ji (Lim Se-Mi), who is a shooting coach at the same high school. They dated for 10 years, but, after his drug scandal, Joo Ka-Ram disappeared. Now, they reunite again while working at the same high school.  Meanwhile, the rugby team has 7 players including its captain Yoon Seong-Joon. Yoon Seong-Joon is in the 3rd year of high school. He has a twin brother who is a member of the junior national soccer team. Yoon Seong-Joon also played soccer in the past, but he switched to rugby due to his lack of talent. He is twisted by envy and feels inferior toward people with talent. Yet, Yoon Seong-Joon is a hard-working person who wants to be r

series.title: Love, Take Two
series.description: Lee Ji Ahn has built her life on strength, dignity, and quiet resilience as a single mother. But everything shifts when her grown daughter, now a med student, stages a late rebellion-and Ji Ahn nexpectedly reconnects with her first love, Ryu Jung Suk. As mother and daughter navigate personal turning points, they discover something neither expected: the right to choose joy, love, and themselves -this time around. Not every love story happens in your twenties.

series.title: My Lovely Journey
series.description: A full-fledged healing trip emotional drama about an idol-turned-travel reporter who has never been in the center in her life, realizing the true success and meaning of life by going on requested trips.

series.title: The Echoes of Survivors: Inside Korea's Tragedies
series.description: This documentary series reveals the harrowing tales of those who survived Korea's gloomiest chapters, shedding a light on long-hidden truths.

series.title: Because I Don't Want To Go Home
series.description: What's wrong with going on a trip alone with a friend of the opposite sex? Yoon Seul who doesn't want to go home and Han Bit who doesn't want to go to the army begin their friendship trip! Wait no I mean, the friendship-destroying romance begins!

series.title: Confidence Man
series.description: A comedy-drama that depicts three crooks extorting large sums of money from people who are stained with desire with grand and unusual plans on the stage of the colorful world of real estate and finance.

series.title: My Troublesome Star
series.description: A drama about a young top actress named Im Se Ra, who gets into an accident on the day she is to receive her Best Actress award, and comes back to work after a 25-year career gap.

series.title: My Youth
series.description: Sunwoo Hae was a popular child actor, who shined in his youth. Due to the greed of the adults around him, he lost his shining light. He barely made it through the turmoil and now lives peacefully as a novelist and florist. Suddenly, Seong Je Yeon appears in front of him. Sunwoo Hae and Seong Je Yeon were each other's first love and they helped each other get through the darkest times of their lives. They reunite after 10 years. The appearance of Je Yeon also reminds him of his past. Meanwhile, Je Yeon works as a team leader for Feel Entertainment. She grew up in a wealthy family, without any worries, but her family suddenly fell into ruin. She now lives more fiercely than anyone else around her. She is driven by reality and only looks for success in her life. To achieve her goal, she finds Sunwoo Hae, who was her first love, and breaks his peace. As she gets involved with him, she also experiences change by confronting her innocent past self.

series.title: Our Golden Days
series.description: A story about finding the true meaning of family through the process of the older generation, and their children understanding each other's pain.

series.title: Dear X
series.description: Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.

series.title: First Lady
series.description: A story that follows an unprecedented incident, in which a married man newly elected as president demands a divorce from his wife, who is to become the first lady. It unfolds during the 67 days leading up to the presidential inauguration, depicting the political intrigue and family secrets that emerge through the intense conflict between the president-elect and his wife.

series.title: A Hundred Memories
series.description: A heartbreaking first love story of a man who was destined to be the fate of two women who were bus guides in the 1980s, and a melodrama, growth, human, comedy of shining youths who were destined to be brilliant.

series.title: You and Everything Else
series.description: From teen years to adulthood, two friends linked by warmth and tension grow apart -- until one is asked to accompany the other through her final days.

series.title: Siren's Kiss
series.description: In  Siren's Kiss , Cha Woo-seok receives a mysterious call from an informant who claims to have evidence of a fraud-related murder. Before revealing the truth, the informant falls to her death. Woo-seok's investigation leads him to Royal Auction and its chief auctioneer, Han Seol-ah, whose three fiancés have all died under suspicious circumstances. To expose the truth, or perhaps to test her, Woo-seok proposes they fake a relationship. As he uncovers her secrets, he realizes he may have stepped into a web he can't escape—and that getting out could cost him everything.

series.title: Ms. Incognito
series.description: A comical human romance about a female bodyguard from a poor family who enters a contract marriage with a terminally ill conglomerate chairman, and has to survive under a false identity for 3 months, while guarding from those who are after her huge inheritance.

series.title: To the Moon
series.description: A comedic survival investment story of three poor office workers who can't get by on their salaries alone, and dream of making a fortune.

series.title: Shin's Project
series.description: Mr. Shin may look like an ordinary chicken shop owner, but he's the kind of person who appears just in time—when tempers flare, fists are about to fly, and chaos looms—to cool things down with one sharp, satisfying line that settles everything. When Philip, a by-the-book rookie judge, is suddenly reassigned to the chicken shop instead of a courtroom, and Sion, a delivery rider secretly working as Mr. Shin's informant, joins the team, the unlikely trio begins to chase the truth and seek new ground for justice. Everything seems to be running smoothly—but one question remains: Who exactly is Mr. Shin?

series.title: A Graceful Liar
series.description: After a difficult childhood with a father who was falsely accused and an absent mother, Jeong-won, now an adult, begins living as the "fake Yeong-chae" at the suggestion of her old friend Yeong-chae at a gathering of rich families. One day, Yeong-chae tries to escape to Paris to avoid an arranged marriage and asks Jeong-won to stand in for her for a month. Living as the "fake Yeong-chae," Jeong-won grows close to Se-hun, the heir to the Jinseong Group. Amidst this, Jeong-won discovers that Yeong-chae stole her designs to achieve success, and that her future mother-in-law is her biological mother. Jeong-won resolves to become the real Yeong-chae and reclaim her life.

series.title: No Mercy
series.description: When a voice phishing scam destroys her family, struggling actress So Min dives into the underworld of deepfake technology to seek revenge. Armed with forged identities and nothing to lose, she infiltrates a powerful crime syndicate—crossing paths with a power-hungry boss, a conflicted cop, and a charmingly dangerous hacker. But as the lies stack up, the question remains: will she bring them down, or be consumed by the very deception she wields?

series.title: Typhoon Family
series.description: A rookie boss inherits his father's business. An ambitious bookkeeper dreams of success. Together, they learn entrepreneurship and adulthood amid crisis.

series.title: Would You Marry Me?
series.description: A sweet and thrilling, 90-day fake honeymoon survival romantic comedy about a man and a woman who are trying to win the ultimate newlywed prize.

series.title: Last Summer
series.description: A work that depicts a three-dimensional romance between a woman who 'hates summer' and a man who 'waits for summer every day' as they reunite after two years. The two people who complete their romance by examining each other from the inside out will unfold against the backdrop of summer.

series.title: Crime Scene Zero
series.description: In this crime-solving reality show, players take on the roles of detectives and suspects. With clues and wits, can they expose the culprit among them?

series.title: Spirit Fingers
series.description: Song U-Yeon (Park Ji-Hu) is an ordinary high school student, who isn't special in any specific thing. Her mother always put her older brother and younger brother before Song U-Yeon and her opinions are usually ignored at home. Due to this, Song U-Yeon doesn't express her feelings and she has low self-esteem.  One day, a good looking man on the street asks her to pose as a model for a group of people. The man is Koo Sun-Ho (Choi Bo-Min) and the group are members of sketch club Spirit Fingers, including their President Nam Geu-Rin (Park Yoo-Na). Song U-Yeon poses on the street for them, but, unlike Song U-Yeon, the members are full of individuality and seem to get along well. This leads Song U-Yeon to join Spirit Fingers. The members encourage and compliment Song U-Yeon, which causes her self-esteem to grow.  Meanwhile, Nam Gi-Jung (Jo Joon-Young) is Club President Nam Geu-Rin's younger brother and he is a high school student and the same age as Song U-Yeon. He has an attractive appearance and models for internet shopping malls as a part-time jpb. Due to Song U-Yeon, he begins to think about his future as a model seriously.

series.title: Nice to Not Meet You
series.description: A romantic comedy about an actor who plays the roles of detectives and wants to become a master of romcoms, and a former political reporter who has fallen from grace to entertainment journalism.

series.title: The Dream Life of Mr. Kim
series.description: A drama that tells the story of a middle-aged man who loses everything he thought was valuable in an instant and, after a long journey, finally discovers his true self, beyond his role as a manager at a large corporation.

series.title: Marie and Her Three Daddies
series.description: A drama depicting the birth of an unusual family, thicker than blood and more tenacious than sperm.

series.title: Idol I
series.description: A romantic comedy drama and suspenseful mystery about a top star lawyer who has been a die-hard fan for 15 years, and an idol who hates his obsessive fans.

series.title: Dynamite Kiss
series.description: A romance between a single woman who pretends to be a married mom in order to get a job, and the team leader who falls in love with her.

series.title: Grand Galaxy Hotel
series.description: Only open in the middle of the night to provide top-class service and console the souls of the dead, the Grand Galaxy Hotel has a new owner, Eun-ha. Upon his arrival, he meets the human hotel manager Sang-soon, who does not fear ghosts.

series.title: Physical: Asia
series.description: Elite athletes from eight countries battle for national pride. After grueling tests of raw strength and endurance, only one flag can claim victory.

series.title: If Wishes Could Kill
series.description: The fears and dreams of teenagers caught between ambition and reality. Using the app is simple: upload a video of your wish and wait for it to come true — at a cost. What shocking truths will they uncover as they grapple with the consequences of their wishes?

series.title: Armored Saurus
series.description: The story of dinosaurs equipped with state-of-the-art suits and their pilots fighting against alien mechanical dinosaur corps.

series.title: Noona, You Are a Woman to Me
Three Idiots in Kenya
series.description: Lee Su-geun, Eun Ji-won and Kyuhyun embark on a dream journey to Kenya — only to find that every meal and adventure is locked behind a wacky challenge.

series.title: Seventeen: Our Chapter
series.description: After 10 years together, Seventeen look back at where they've been to uncover where they'll go next.

series.title: Heroes Next Door
series.description: It tells the thrilling and humorous story of a reserve special forces unit that comes together not to protect the country or promote world peace but solely to safeguard their families and neighborhood.

series.title: Surely Tomorrow
series.description: In their twenties, Lee Kyeong-do and Seo Ji-woo part ways after two passionate relationships. A decade later, they meet again as a reporter who covers an adultery scandal and the wife of the man at the center of that scandal. Reuniting in their late thirties, their youth has passed, but their love remains vivid. Kyungdo now strives to prove to her and to himself that he still loves her.

series.title: The Judge Returns
series.description: Based on a web novel, this courtroom time-slip drama tells the story of an upright judge named Lee Han Yeong, who dies after being falsely accused, and ends up 20 years in the past.

series.title: Portraits of Delusion
series.description: Set in Gyeongseong in 1935, the series follows painter Yun Il Ho, who is tasked with creating a portrait of Song Jeong Hwa—a mysterious woman who has remained out of public view for more than half a century and is the subject of countless rumors. As he steps into her world, a web of secrets begins to unravel, pulling him deeper into a suspense-laced narrative.

series.title: I am Boxer
series.description: From 30-year boxing veteran Don Lee comes the ultimate survival competition. Ninety boxers, regardless of age, weight, or profession, gather to prove they're the best. They'll face off in explosive matches and missions on an epic scale. Who will survive to the end and be crowned the champion?

series.title: No Tail to Tell
series.description: Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a football player -- altering both of their fates.

series.title: Spring Fever
series.description: Spring Fever : the tiredness people often feel in spring. Yun Bom, a teacher with a frozen heart, arrives at a small rural school and slowly rediscovers joy through Seon Jae Gyu's warmth.

series.title: Baemon House
series.description: The very first behind-the-scenes look at the newly, but upcoming K-POP Group BABYMONSTER that shows their everyday life, providing a warm and lively glimpse into their home and personalities.

series.title: Villains
series.description: A bloody confrontation takes place between villains over super-notes, which is a counterfeit bill of extreme high quality.

series.title: Undercover Miss Hong
series.description: Set against the backdrop of the 1990s, this retro office comedy follows Hong Geum Bo, a no-nonsense financial regulator in her 30s who lives for her work. But when suspicious activity surfaces at a major securities firm, her career takes an unexpected turn. Tasked with uncovering the truth, Geum Bo goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate, diving headfirst into an unfamiliar world of office politics, outdated tech, and hilarious culture clashes.

series.title: Love Me
series.description: A drama that portrays the story of a family that is a little selfish and perhaps more ordinary than their own, who cherished each other's lives as they grew to love each other.

series.title: Dream to You
series.description: A romantic comedy exploring the lives of two individuals at different crossroads in life. Reporter Lee Jae has transitioned from a fearless teen driven by dreams to a disillusioned 20-something facing the harsh realities of life, and finally becoming an adult in her 30s who feels like she has settled into mediocrity. On the other hand, film director Su Bin has lived a life designed by his parents during his teenage years but eventually broke free and charged through his 20s and ultimately achieved the dream he had longed for by his 30s.

series.title: Phantom Lawyer
series.description: While Shin Yi Rang dreams of joining a prestigious law firm, he's constantly rejected due to his father's criminal past. Undeterred, he "borrows" money from his mother and opens up his own law firm in a building formerly owned by a shaman. His life and career take a supernatural turn after incense he found in a desk drawer gifts him with the ability to communicate with – and be possessed by – ghosts. With unexpected help from elite lawyer Han Na Hyun, Yi Rang is able to get justice for his first ghostly client, although she's reluctant to admit that spirits are truly speaking to Yi Rang. As their peculiar partnership continues to develop, Yi Rang and Na Hyun find themselves growing closer in more ways than one, all while helping lingering spirits get the closure they need to pass on.

series.title: Terror Man
series.description: Min Jung Woo has a special ability, one that lets him see whenever a path leads to an unfortunate future. He uses his eyes of "Misfortune" to spot unfortunate events and tries to stop them, leading him to become a terrorist feared by the people.

series.title: Solo Leveling
series.description: An E-rank Hunter gains extraordinary abilities after a near-death experience and becomes humanity's unexpected hope against monstrous threats.

series.title: Positively Yours
series.description: The story of Jang Hui Won, a successful woman who prioritizes her career over marriage. She works late-night shifts and weekends, but one night, her life takes an unexpected turn when she impulsively becomes pregnant with the company's president and insists on marriage.

series.title: Physical: Welcome to Mongolia
series.description: After completing the grueling "Physical: Asia" finale, Team Mongolia leads their Korean teammates on a Mongolian trip of outdoor challenges and culture.

series.title: Scarecrow
series.description: Criminal profiler Kang Tae Joo is pulled out of retirement by a chilling summons: an imprisoned serial killer has been linked to additional unsolved deaths through DNA evidence, but he insists that Tae Joo joins the investigation, believing that Tae Joo can prove his innocence. Tae Joo is brought back into a world he thought he'd left behind 33 years earlier, forcing him to face ambitious prosecutor Cha Si Young, with whom he shares a difficult past, in pursuit of the truth. But as with many cold cases, the truth isn't as straightforward as it seems – and Tae Joo might be more involved than even he knows. Can Tae Joo finally close the chapter on the "Scarecrow" murders for good, or will a new twist upend his life?

series.title: I Kill U
series.description: The story unfolds as a part-timer who was once a promising Taekwondo player, but now has a resemblance to the biological granddaughter of Beomhan Construction, who was accused of being the main culprit in a hit-and-run while drunk, and takes on the role of appearing in the media on her behalf.

series.title: Muscle Farmers
series.description: Five physical strength entertainers help with farming work by harvesting various crops.

series.title: Boyfriend on Demand
series.description: Seo Mi-rae is worn out by work. Love? It's the last thing on her mind. But a virtual dating service sparks feelings - and maybe a real shot at romance.

series.title: Bloody Flower
series.description: A serial killer who has the ability to cure all incurable diseases, posing a shocking question that overturns law and common sense and building viewers' anticipation.

series.title: Honour
series.description: Ra Young, Shin Jae, and Hyun Jin are lawyers at LnJ, a law firm for women who are victims of sexual abuse. Their relationship is well-defined, starting with Shin Jae's leadership as CEO of the firm. Ra Young serves as a messenger, regarded as a celebrity lawyer with outstanding eloquence, while Hyun Jin always rushes to the scene to find out evidence. They start to investigate a sexual abuse case involving underage students, and they confront the challenging situation head-on against the cartel of sexual abuse on digital platforms. As they approach the truth of the case, their lives begin to fall into danger, while their past memories haunt them repeatedly. Will they be able to save the victims and overcome the bruises from their past? It is the perfect time to retrieve their lost honour.

series.title: Our Universe
series.description: A pair of in-laws, whose constant quarrels have turned affection into animosity, suddenly find themselves responsible for raising their 20-month-old nephew after the unexpected accident of his parents. What follows is a chaotic yet heartwarming romance under one roof.

series.title: Agent Kim Reactivated
series.description: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

series.title: The Art of Sarah
series.description: A supposed luxury maven. A detective with a keen eye. As he digs into her shifting story, the truth behind a murder case slowly comes to light.

series.title: Mini Teuggongdae
series.description: Four animal superheroes called the miniforce transform into robots to protect small and defenceless creatures from the hands of scheming villains.

series.title: Home Town Takeover Canada
series.description: Port Alberni has long been seen as just a gas stop on the way to Tofino. Now Bryan and Sarah Baeumler have 12 weeks to change that. With help from guest stars like Home Town's Ben & Erin Napier, and Scott McGillivray and Sarah Keenleyside, they surprise local changemakers with life-changing home renovations, culminating in an emotional grand re-opening that puts this underdog town back on the map.

series.title: Archie Bunker's Place
series.description: Archie opens up a tavern in Queens complete with a liberal new business partner Murray Klein.

series.title: Cooking with the Stars
series.description: Emma Willis and Tom Allen present the celebrity cookery series where famous faces will be cooking up a storm week by week in a bid to outdo their rivals. Each of the celebrity contestants are paired with a professional chef who will mentor and teach them to prepare restaurant quality dishes

series.title: The Other Bennet Sister
series.description: The Other Bennet Sister  is a fresh spin around the ballroom for one of Jane Austen's most unassuming characters: Mary Bennet – the seemingly unremarkable and overlooked middle sister in Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice. The series takes as its premise that - when it comes to the Bennet sisters - while we dream of being Lizzy, in reality most us are more like Mary...  Unlike her sisters, Mary isn't your typical period drama heroine. She is awkward, anxious, preachy, full of facts, a terrible singer… overlooked by her mother and seemingly destined to an empty dance card for the rest of her life… until Mary takes matters into her own hands.   The Other Bennet Sister  gives Mary Bennet the epic love story nobody predicted for her, taking her from her family home in Meryton to the soirees of Regency London and the peaks and vales of the Lake District - all in search of independence, romance and, most elusive of all, self-love and acceptance.

series.title: Universal Basic Guys
series.description: In  Universal Basic Guys  brothers Mark and Hank Hoagies suddenly find themselves with no jobs when the Glantontown Hot Dog factory switches over to automation. Lucky for them, the town started a radical Universal Basic Income pilot program, giving all residents of Glantontown $3,000 per month with no strings attached. Now, Mark, Hank and the rest of their local buddies are once again kids in the summertime, overflowing with the perilous combo of free time and stupid ideas. This is a show about men trying to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed.

series.title: Animal Control
series.description: Animal Control  is a workplace comedy following a group of Animal Control workers whose lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not.

series.title: Colourblocks
series.description: The animated adventures of friends who bring colour to the world. Learn about colours through adventure and play with the  Colourblocks .

series.title: Waffle's After School Club
series.description: Sitcom fun with Waffle the Wonder Dog at after-school club. Mr Brooklyn-Bell is in charge, but with Waffle, Mrs Hobbs and George in the mix, there's plenty of mayhem, mess and laughter.

series.title: Tralala
series.description: Tralala  and her Dad live an idyllic life in a world where cloud-sheep sing, hills talk, and ordinary events unfurl into imaginative adventures with friends from everywhere - even under the sofa!

series.title: Sofia the First: Magical Friends
series.description: Welcome to the Charmswell School for Royal Magic! Spend time with Sofia and her Royal Friends, where she takes you on a sparkling tour of her brand-new royal school, where every castle shines with its own special kind of magic. Along the way, she'll introduce you to her old and new friends — Pepper, Clover, Layla, Zane, and Camila — each with amazing talents and magical gifts of their own. With Sofia as your guide, there's no better way to discover the magic of Charmswell!

series.title: Home and Away
series.description: Home and Away  follows the lives and loves of the residents in Summer Bay, a fictional seaside town of New South Wales. The series initially focuses on the Fletcher family – Tom, Pippa and their five foster children, Frank Morgan, Carly Morris, Lynn Davenport, Steven Matheson and Sally Fletcher – who relocated from the city and moved into the Summer Bay House, where they took on the new job of running the caravan park, and eventually took in a sixth foster child, Bobby Simpson.

series.title: Take Charge of My Heart
series.description: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

series.title: The Blank Menu for You
series.description: In this quirky eatery, guests place open-ended orders that chefs interpret into custom dishes — a delectable talk show where every story inspires a meal.

series.title: Still Shining
series.description: After falling in love as teens, two young adults drift apart — only to reunite 10 years later and confront their heartbreak, growth and new challenges.

series.title: The Practical Guide to Love
series.description: Blind dates seem like the most efficient way to meet someone. So Ui-yeong, still single despite yearning for love, decides to seek romance through blind dates. After a few attempts, two very different men step into her life—Tae-seop, quietly attentive, and Ji-su, playful and refreshing—leading her on an unexpected journey toward understanding what love truly means.

series.title: Mad Concrete Dreams
series.description: In Korea, nothing defines success more than owning a building. Ki Su-jong, once an ordinary office worker, believes that going all in—risking everything and drowning in debt—to finally become a landlord will be his way out. But when global capital swoops in and threatens to push his building into foreclosure, Su-jong clings to a desperate plan with his best friend: a staged kidnapping in the building's basement that spirals into a real one. Trapped in a chain of crimes that could destroy his life or save it, Su-jong is forced to make impossible choices. How far will he go to keep his dream from collapsing?

series.title: Concrete Market
series.description: After the Great Earthquake, the world is razed to the ground. In the lone apartment complex left standing, survivors have established the Hwang Gung Market, where cash is dead and canned food is the new currency. Everything, from fuel to intelligence, is traded here. Park Sang-yong, the President of the Merchants, rules the market with an iron fist, forcing people to find their own ways to survive under his absolute order. But the status quo is shattered when a mysterious girl, He-ro, sneaks in to steal canned food. After discovering Sang-yong's fatal secret, she proposes a treacherous deal to his right-hand man, Tae-jin. As the Market's solid order begins to crack, alliance and betrayal become mere choices for survival. Who will endure to emerge as the master of the Market?

series.title: Climax
series.description: In a desperate attempt to revitalize his stagnant career, prosecutor Bang Tae Seop hatches an absurd but daring plan: take down the mayor of Seoul by exposing her corrupt ties to Lee Yang Mi, the head of the WR Group conglomerate. Tae Seop recruits Hwang Jeong Won to serve as an informant and manages to convince Kwon Jong Uk, a WR Group heir with his own grudge against Yang Mi, to join his cause. However, Tae Seop soon finds himself in a more complicated situation than he initially expected when he discovers that his wife Chu Sang Ah, a formerly loved actress, may be hiding dangerous secrets from him.

series.title: Doctor Shin
series.description: Top actress Momo is preparing to marry Ju Shin, the accomplished director of a neurosurgery hospital who seems to have everything. But a sudden accident leaves her body intact while her brain is fatally damaged, plunging her into a coma. Faced with the devastating possibility of losing the woman he loves, genius neurosurgeon Ju Shin makes a desperate decision and ventures into forbidden medical territory. In a final attempt to save her, he performs an unprecedented "brain change" surgery, transferring another soul into Momo's body. When she opens her eyes again, the soul within her is no longer the woman he once loved. If another soul inhabits the body of the person you love, can that love remain the same? A forbidden choice made to save love unfolds into an unforeseen fate and devastating consequences.

series.title: We Are All Trying Here
series.description: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

series.title: My Royal Nemesis
series.description: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.

series.title: Sold Out on You
series.description: A workaholic home shopping host heads to the countryside to get her sales back on top, but a mysterious farmer shakes up her plans — and her heart

series.title: Gold Land
series.description: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring's gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

series.title: Ready or Not: Texas
series.description: No plans, just vibes. When two best friends and their crew set off for Texas on an entirely unscripted adventure, there's no telling what's coming next.

series.title: The Scandal
series.description: In Joseon's world of rank and reputation, an aristocratic wife and an infamous libertine pull a reserved lady into a scheme where love turns dangerous.

series.title: Our Sticky Love
series.description: Amnesia, small-town hijinks and a shadowy past — classic tropes collide in this rom-com about a star prosecutor and the boxing coach who upends her life.

series.title: The Husband
series.description: Kang Tae Ju, a former neurosurgeon who now serves as a hospital director engages in an extreme fight with a criminal with a human face to save his wife who was kidnapped right before divorce.

series.title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
series.description: In the game of life, we all face countless quests of choice. Kang Sung-jae, who enlisted to escape a harsh reality, one day encounters a mysterious virtual "Quest" screen to become an army cook. With each quest he clears, hidden secrets of the base, even those tied to his father's death, begin to surface.

series.title: Absolute Value of Romance
series.description: A quiet student by day, a romance novelist by night, Eui-ju is inspired when four gorgeous teachers appear: icy Woo-su, lively Da-ju, gruff Gi-jeon, and gentle Dong-ju. She writes them into her new novel, which blows up overnight! But her secret is discovered by Woo-su, her worst enemy since day one. She accepts his deal to protect her secret, but can she finish this novel unscathed?

series.title: A Love Other Than Yours
series.description: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

series.title: See You At Work Tomorrow!
series.description: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

series.title: Reborn Rookie
series.description: Kang Yong Ho is the chairman of the Choiseong Group, a leading conglomerate in South Korea. He built the company by himself, and he is now known as the "God of Business". One day, he has an unexpected accident. He collides with a young man named Hwang Jun Hyeon. Hwang Jun Hyeon is a soccer player who has just joined the League 1 team FC Choiseong. Due to the accident, Chairman Kang Yong Ho's soul is swapped with soccer player Hwang Jun Hyeon's soul. With Chairman Kang Yong Ho's soul in Hwang Jun Hyeon's body, he applies to the Choiseong Group as a new employee. He begins his unpredictable journey with his soul as an outstanding businessman and the young body of Hwang Jun Hyeon.

series.title: Doctor on the Edge
series.description: Elite plastic surgeon Do Jiui has his perfect life turned upside down when he's unexpectedly sent to the remote island of Pyeondongdo as a public health doctor. Surrounded by the sea, the island is more than just isolation for him, as past trauma has turned the ocean into an unknowable terror and a massive prison. Intrusive locals and grotesque bugs turn life into a living hell for the city man. Amid it all, a mysterious nurse, Yuk Hari, appears. Hiding secrets behind her gentle smile, she always seems to be nearby when Jiui is overwhelmed by his fear of the sea. As the two become entangled on the small island, can Jiui overcome his past and escape safely?

series.title: The Thought Verification Zone: The Community
series.description: A political and economic survival experiment where strangers with opposing beliefs must build a functioning society while competing for power, resources, and money, exposing how difficult cooperation becomes when everyone wants something different.

series.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
series.description: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

series.title: The Apartment Job
series.description: A once-feared gangster enters the race for apartment association president, driven by greed for hidden funds. But his quest for easy money unravels a web of corruption—and against all odds, he emerges as the unlikely champion of the residents.

series.title: Spooky in Love
series.description: When a ghost-seeing heiress and an ace prosecutor discover that a single touch makes them an unlikely crime-solving duo, they team up to uncover unsolved murders. Cheon Yeo-ri, a hotel CEO haunted by spirits of people who died unjustly, joins forces with prosecutor Ma Kang-wook to investigate paranormal cases. As they unravel mysteries together, their strange partnership soon turns into something more romantic.

series.title: Jae-seok's B&B Rules!
series.description: The guest is king — but so is the host! Yu Jae-seok opens his first B&B, where he runs things his way and treats guests to his signature games.

series.title: Notes from the Last Row
series.description: A failed writer-turned-professor finds rare talent in a student's writing — and grows obsessed with his draft as their private lessons go off course.

series.title: Wind Up
series.description: A sports fantasy growth drama based on baseball, that tells the story of a high school baseball player and an unknown transfer student

series.title: Love in Sync
series.description: An emotional transference romance that unfolds as a woman who denies empathy and a man who bears the burden of empathy come to share each other's emotions. Cha Eun Hwan, a man who bears others' emotions excessively. He is a psychological counseling expert who has gained widespread popularity for his unique counseling methods. However, after becoming entangled in an unexpected incident, his everyday life and emotional balance begin to unravel. As he falls into despair, a figure connected to his past appears, bringing changes to both his life and his emotions. Yoo Ji An, a former girl group member who was once called the "Nation's Idol" and enjoyed explosive popularity, is now working as an actress. Having lived her life suppressing her emotions under her mother's strict control since childhood, Ji An faces a crisis due to controversy over her acting skills, stemming from her lack of empathy. She then meets Cha Eun Hwan, a psychological counseling expert, and unexpectedly experiences "emotional transference." Through this experience, she begins to rediscover her lost emotions and grow as a person.

series.title: Whale Star: The Gyeongseong Mermaid
series.description: Set in 1926 Gyeongseong during Japanese occupation that follows the story of Kang Ui Hyeon, a man who dedicates everything to his country, and Su A, a woman who risks her life to protect him. A Korean reimaging of Hans Christian Andersen's "The Little Mermaid."

series.title: The Love Lab
series.description: An innovative dating experiment reality show that breaks away from the conventions of traditional dating programs. Unfamiliar men and women are placed in extreme and controlled environments, facing unexpected experiments such as blind dates in bed and romances in isolation. Through unpredictable situations, the show dynamically captures the participants' raw, instinctive emotions and the realistic changes in their relationships.

series.title: My Bias, My Boss
series.description: For thirteen years, Nam Da Reum has been a dedicated fan of idol star Lee Chan. When she lands a job at fashion company APPELLO, she's shocked to find out that her beloved idol co-founded the company. Da Reum resolves to hide her identity as a fan and prove that she can be a professional. However, when she starts work, she's faced instead with workaholic CEO Kang Ha Gi, Chan's childhood friend. Meanwhile, Ha Gi seems to harbor hidden, unrequited feelings for Chan, and Chan struggles to maintain his public persona while dealing with a complicated personal life. As the three become entangled, Da Reum finds herself caught between her past obsession with Chan and a growing, unexpected connection with Ha Gi.    .

series.title: Mousetrap
series.description: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

series.title: A Bona Fide Killer
series.description: Ordinary working mom Yu Bo Na is secretly the legendary assassin Kingfisher, who eliminates criminals beyond the reach of the law. Returning to work after three years of maternity leave, she resumes a perilous double life, balancing work, childcare, housework, and assassinations. As her missions grow more dangerous, a detective hunting a mysterious killer and a husband beginning to suspect the truth threaten to expose her secret. From school drop-offs to taking down criminals, every moment is a high-wire act with no room to slip up. The instant her true identity surfaces, she stands to lose everything. Can Yu Bo Na keep her identity hidden and protect both worlds as a loving wife and mother to her family and a ruthless killer to her targets?

series.title: The Affair Was Just the Beginning
series.description: Park Kyung Hee appears to have it all: a thriving interior design business, an adoring social media following, and the perfect family image. To elevate her success, she orchestrates a friendship with her wealthy neighbor, Soo Jung, hoping to leverage Soo Jung's connections into an investment into her business. However, her carefully curated life unravels when she investigates rumors of her husband Lim Jae Hong's infidelity, only to discover him disposing of a dead body – and their daughter is allegedly responsible for the killing. Despite attempting to cover up the incident, they receive an anonymous message that someone has recorded them, forcing Kyung Hee to navigate a treacherous web of blackmail and deceit as they try to put their lives back in order.

series.title: Korean Fried Chicken Rhapsody
series.description: This documentary series explores how traditional recipes have shaped Korea's food scene, highlighting the popular pairing of fried chicken and beer.

series.title: Family Register
series.description: Branded as a "mistress' daughter," Na Ji Ni carries lifelong stigma. No Yeong Ju, wrecked by her husband's betrayal, lives with unhealed wounds. Forced under one roof by the man who ruined them both, the two confront buried pain, clashing families, and years of prejudice—fighting to turn bitterness into strength, and maybe into something like family.

series.title: Metal Cardbot
series.description: Jun becomes the rightful owner of the amazing Metal Breath!  Together with Blue Cop, they will discover all the Metal Cardbots!

series.title: History of Life: A Study in Evolution
series.description: History of Life: A Study in Evolution  will explore the history of life from its humble beginnings as single-celled organisms, to its great blossoming and proliferation which took place over the course of eons. Through vivid 3D computer imagery, we will resurrect the ancient creatures that once ruled the earth and chronicle their rise and fall. Also, we will examine how plant life evolved and changed, and learn how the dinosaurs first took flight to become the ancestors of modern birds. We will unravel the greatest mysteries of life, such as how creatures moved from the sea to land, as well as the origins of mating and sex.

series.title: Pawobaeteul Wachika
series.description: The series is set in the near future, when an automobile company named JHC Motors is depicted to have created the Watch Cars, which are miniature sentient robotic cars that are supposed to have become good companions to children and adults alike. Watch Cars are depicted to have become a global trend. There is a Battle League where Watch Cars and their trainers battle. Jino, one of the young Watch Car Masters, goes to the Watch Car Battle League with his Watch Car Blue-will, but The Rangers of Darkness an evil force to takeover al the watch cars in The city, Jino and his friends must stop them.

series.title: The Ordinary Jackpot
series.description: Things rarely change, but everything began to change. Eun-tae, who has been working as an ordinary employee, is burnt out from everything that happens to him. Everything from work to relationships with others, his life is filled with boredom. Suddenly, he becomes a lottery winner and gets 1.3 billion won. While it is a huge amount, realistically, it is hard for him to even purchase his own house in Seoul. After reviewing everything, he decides to live his life as he used to, but with a somewhat different mindset, as he has "insurance" that he can depend on.

series.title: Take a Hike!
series.description: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

series.title: One-Room TA
series.description: When college student Uyun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jinhyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jinhyeong moves in with him, and that's when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He's thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having Uyun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jinhyeong's ideas are, Uyun doesn't entirely hate it...?

series.title: Mecard Ball
series.description: Basketball, Baseball, Soccer... When it comes to handling a ball, Cha Youngwoong, a fifth-grade elementary school student, exhibits overwhelming abilities. One day, while cleaning out the warehouse at the request of his mother, he discovers a mysterious marble. At that moment, the villain duo "Team MABORI" and the monster creature 'Pachyla' appear to break the warehouse and threaten the hero, but With the help of the Mechanimal 'Akan' hidden in the warehouse, he uses a mysterious orb - 'Mecard Ball' to succeed in defeating them. After that, Cha Youngwoong hears a surprising story from Akan... Mechanimals living with ball energy that have existed on Earth for a long time. Cha Youngwoong's ability to handle a ball freely is said to be related to his mother. He is determined to find the lost memories of his mother and protect the peace of the earth. Mysterious characters appear one after another in front of Cha Youngwoong who begins to collect Mecard Balls and Mechanimals, and a battle unfolds. From the mysterious girl Sera to Kirayan who threatens the earth. Will he be able to regain his mother's memory and protect the peace of the earth with Akan?

series.title: A Trap Called Desire
series.description: One accusation destroys an ordinary life overnight. Falsely accused of murder, Ko Eun Seol loses her name, her family, and everything she once called her own. Instead of running, she turns hunter. Eun Seol sets out to reclaim what was stolen from her and confront those who sacrificed innocent lives to protect their own ambitions. As she uncovers one hidden truth after another, the fragile alliances built on greed begin to fracture, and the world sustained by lies starts to collapse. Every truth she reveals brings her closer to the conspiracy that branded her a murderer and closer to those determined to silence her. Can Eun Seol expose the conspiracy behind the life that was stolen from her and finally reclaim it? The perfect lie begins to crumble because of the one woman it failed to erase.

series.title: Bad Kid Good Partner
series.description: Top star Yu Il and an unknown actor Hye Seong are forced to play a fake couple after a scandal.

series.title: Just Too Bored
series.description: A web-drama depicting office romance that's full of mystery, secrets, and interns trying to navigate through work life.

series.title: EN-O'CLOCK
series.description: A variety show around the K-Pop group ENHYPEN where they complete games, obstacle courses and much more.

series.title: King of Survival: Tribal War
series.description: 12-member cast, which fights its way through the jungle and "survival" for the "throne", also consists of the best talents in their fields. Those who have proven their skills through various survival pastimes, such as backcountry exploration experts, martial arts, national team athletes and former special forces, put their pride on the line and give it all to the "King of Survival".

series.title: Your Personal Taxi
series.description: There are times when all we want is for someone to truly listen to our story. And sometimes, we come across a song that feels like it's telling that story for us. Welcome to  Your Personal Taxi —a special ride where music plays alongside memories, and your story is met with a listening ear. This isn't just any car—it's a personalized classic, and there's something quietly mysterious about it. Passengers with ordinary yet extraordinary lives step in to share personal stories, along with the songs that carry their emotions.

series.title: Shasha and Milo
series.description: Shasha and Milo are the newly activated Crescent Moon Guardians. Imbued with the power to transform between human, cat and a formidable hybrid form, Shasha and Milo are tasked with protecting Crescent Island from the dark forces that lurk beneath it... whilst navigating the daily complexities of preteen life.

series.title: Deadly Tag
series.description: Chase, be chased, and survive. A deadly game of tag begins.

series.title: Walk to Kwangya
series.description: Han So Ran, who doesn't have a single friend in the real world, her only true friend is 'ke-Soran' who lives in Kwangya. One day, she accidentally encounters her ex-boyfriend who broke up with her by ghosting her four years ago, and he was living in the so-called "Analog Mode" as he does not use a smartphone or SNS. The secret that So Ran and ke-So Ran who lives in both Kwangya and the real world that cannot be told to Do Kwang starts to be dug up.

series.title: The Substitute
series.description: Depicts the story of a high-achieving, low-income student who takes the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) for another person to avoid blackmail. Children are placed on an exam stage where they risk falling behind in life if they do not complete the CSAT safely. To obtain the "score" that will determine their future, a survival CSAT war unfolds thrillingly with betrayals and tricks everywhere. It is expected to expose the dark side of entrance exams unflinchingly through the "unfair" children who search for the correct answer amid extreme dilemmas. Kang Geon Tae, the miracle of a "special low-income scholarship student" who does not lose the top rank at Jeonggyeong High, where wealthy people abound. He drew a perfect blueprint toward the first cornerstone of life, the "prestigious university," but the choices he made to survive return as the only stain. He is a figure who falls into a whirlpool by Nam Jae Yeop's irresistible proposal amid the greatest crisis of his life. Nam Jae Yeop, a hexagon full of a gold spoon background, warm visuals and excellent grades, but everything is a mask. series.title: Vidya Gaem Awards
series.description: The  Vidya Gaem Awards  are a yearly event, featuring 4chan's "/v/ - Video Games" board voting on the best and worst in video games of the year. Hosts provide commentary on the winners and explain why they won. The award presentations also feature skits from creators in the community, and later shows feature game trailers from independent game developers.

series.title: Phony
series.description: Phony  is a coming-of-age mystery about a teenager who wakes up in the hospital after a car accident to discover his mom - his only parent and his best friend - appears to have been replaced by an impostor.

series.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
series.description: What happens in Vegas usually stays in Vegas, but behind the flashing lights and million-dollar jackpots is a world visitors have never seen before. For the first time, Discovery pulls back the curtain on the legendary Golden Nugget, one of Las Vegas' most iconic casinos, to follow the larger-than-life personalities responsible for managing demanding high rollers, millions of dollars, and nonstop drama every day.     Just off the chaos of busy Fremont Street, cameras capture the real-life and often shocking moments that unfold around the clock: unruly guests, high-pressure special events and the relentless efforts required to keep thousands of people safe and entertained each day. Whether it's breaking up a late-night club brawl, responding to an embarrassing medical emergency or racing to move sharks from a 200,000-gallon shark tank, the staff must be ready for whatever Vegas throws their way.

series.title: From a Bird's Eye View
series.description: The series, set in London, follows the misadventures of two International Airline stewardesses: Millie Grover, British, meddlesome, and scatterbrained; and Maggie Ralston, her partner, a level-headed American girl on loan from the U.S. to International's European division.

series.title: Mickey Spillane's Mike Hammer
series.description: Mickey Spillane's Mike Hammer  with Darren McGavin, a hard-boiled private detective created by novelist Mickey Spillane. The adventures of New York-based gumshoe Mike Hammer as he regularly played judge, jury and executioner to an assortment of bad guys.

series.title: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death
series.description: Deep in the manosphere, an underground movement promises to unlock human potential - bulging muscles, bigger penises, eternal youth. At its center is Dr. Tony Huge, a guru pushing homemade biohacks on a devoted following willing to risk everything for the cause. When Leo & Longevity, a penis-enlargement expert and one of Tony's closest allies, is found dead in Thailand, alpha-male influencers become online sleuths, running wild with theories and questioning Tony Huge and his right-hand man, Connor Murphy. Soon, a darker pattern emerges: Leo isn't the first of the inner circle to die under mysterious circumstances. Will he be the last?

series.title: The Terminal List: Dark Wolf
series.description: The Terminal List: Dark Wolf  is a prequel series with an origin story that follows Ben Edwards throughout his journey from the Navy SEALs to the clandestine side of CIA Special Operations. The series is an espionage thriller that explores the darker side of warfare and the human cost that comes with it.

series.title: Colt .45
series.description: Colt .45  (also known as  The Colt Cousins ) was an American Western series loosely based on the 1950 Warner Bros. film of the same name Christopher Colt was apparently a gun salesman but was in fact a government agent tracking down notorious bad guys.

series.title: Here Come the Irish
series.description: Here Come the Irish  documents life on and off the field of the legendary University of Notre Dame Fighting Irish football team through exclusive behind-the-scenes footage and interviews with those closest to the program.

series.title: St. Denis Medical
series.description: St. Denis Medical  is a mockumentary about an underfunded, understaffed Oregon hospital where the dedicated doctors and nurses try their best to treat patients while maintaining their own sanity.

series.title: Art Detectives
series.description: Art Detectives  is a compelling new original crime series centered around the Heritage Crime Unit, a police department consisting of art loving DI Mick Palmer and straight-talking DC Shazia Malik. Together, they solve murders connected to the world of art and antiques, from Old Master paintings, to Banksy street art, medieval manuscripts and collectible vinyl.  Throughout the season, the artfully astute detectives encounter a fake Vermeer, Viking gold, a rare Chinese vase and items rescued from the Titanic. It's a rich and colorful world driven by greed, obsession, lust and revenge. Mick navigates these demanding cases while managing a budding romance with museum curator Rosa and the sudden reappearance of his charismatic father, Ron, who just happens to be one of Britain's most notorious forgers.

series.title: The Age of Innocence
series.description: Based on Wharton's novel of forbidden love in 19th-century New York,  The Age of Innocence  follows a passionate and heartrending will they, won't they love triangle while exploring themes of freedom, duty, identity, and love in all its forms. The new take promises to be true to Wharton's novel but will speak to a new generation as it traverses the ballrooms and bedrooms of its young characters, asking what is love — and what is lust. And should we ultimately be driven by our heads, or by our hearts?

series.title: Inside of You with Michael Rosenbaum
series.description: Inside of You with Michael Rosenbaum  is a podcast, recorded series inside of the home of Michael Rosenbaum (Sorority Boys, Smallville). Listen as he invites celebrities, athletes, musicians, or anyone he finds interesting to sit next to on the couch, while he probes them for the most interesting stories they have.

series.title: Celebrity Scares
series.description: An unscripted, immersive horror-interview series that pairs genre legends and celebrities with premier haunted attractions for terrifying, raw conversations while navigating jump scares.

series.title: Disaster Strike Force
series.description: Leading geoscientist Dr. Molly Martin sees Earth at a tipping point as climate change fuels natural disasters. Rather than wait for bureaucracy, she and her family join international disaster response unit R.E.A.C.T.

series.title: NCIS: New York
series.description: Legendary NCIS Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to their field office, partnering with a roguish agent and helping lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.
The best analysis of local, national and international events from an Australian perspective. Hosted by Sarah Ferguson, with political commentary from  7.30  Political Editor Sabra Lane in Canberra.

series.title: Bobby's Triple Threat
series.description: In  Bobby's Triple Threat  one extraordinarily talented and eager chef is challenged to go against the trio of culinary titans handpicked by Bobby himself for a chance to take home $25,000. The stakes couldn't be higher, as Bobby celebrates and tests the most talented chefs in America. This is Bobby's game and Bobby's chefs, and there's only one rule: it's all or nothing.
